建议：前 3 站讲烷烃（饱和），后 3 站讲烯烃（不饱和）——先分清「单键 vs 双键」这条分界线，后面反应就好记了。Tip: stops 1-3 cover alkanes (saturated), 4-6 cover alkenes (unsaturated) — lock in the "single vs double bond" divide first and the reactions will follow.

1 烷烃：饱和碳氢化合物Alkanes: saturated hydrocarbons Alkanes烷烃
这一站要你会：写出烷烃通式 CnH2n+2，说出「饱和」的含义，并解释沸点为什么随碳数升高。Goal: write the general formula CnH2n+2, explain what "saturated" means, and say why boiling point rises with chain length.
把烷烃想成一群老实人排队手拉手：每个碳伸四只手，一手拉氢、一手拉碳，从来不双扣。手都握满了、没有空出来的手，所以叫「饱和」。碳链越长，就像绳子越长、接触面越大，分子之间缠得越紧，想把它们掰开（沸腾）就得烧更多能量——所以沸点随碳数升高。Think of alkanes as a queue of polite people holding hands: every carbon holds four hands — some to hydrogens, some to carbons — and never double-grips. All hands are full, none spare, so it is "saturated". A longer chain is like a longer rope with more surface to tangle, so the molecules cling together harder and need more energy to pull apart — that is why boiling point rises with chain length.
必须记牢的三点：Three points to learn:
  • 通式：CnH2n+2。甲烷 CH₄、乙烷 C₂H₆、丙烷 C₃H₈……每多一个碳，就多一个 CH₂。General formula: CnH2n+2. Methane CH₄, ethane C₂H₆, propane C₃H₈… each extra carbon adds one CH₂.
  • 只含 C–C 单键（和 C–H 键），每个碳形成 4 个单键 → 这就叫饱和（saturated）。Only C–C single bonds (plus C–H), each carbon making 4 single bonds → this is saturated.
  • 同系物（homologous series）：甲烷 methane、乙烷 ethane、丙烷 propane、丁烷 butane、戊烷 pentane、己烷 hexane、庚烷 heptane、辛烷 octane——记住前四个就够考试用了。Homologous series: methane, ethane, propane, butane, pentane, hexane, heptane, octane — learning the first four is enough for the exam.
  • 沸点随碳数升高：碳链越长，分子间力（van der Waals 力）越强。Boiling point rises with carbon number because longer chains have stronger intermolecular (van der Waals) forces.
别混词：这里的「饱和」是说只含单键；别和「饱和溶液」的饱和搞混——那是说溶质已经不能再溶了，两码事。Don't mix up the word: "saturated" here means only single bonds; it has nothing to do with a "saturated solution", which means no more solute can dissolve.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons with the general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, containing only single C–C and C–H bonds. Their boiling points increase with chain length because the intermolecular forces become stronger.
例题Example
某烷烃的相对分子质量是 44（C 的相对原子质量 12，H 为 1）。求它的分子式和名称。An alkane has relative molecular mass 44 (C = 12, H = 1). Find its molecular formula and name.
① 设碳数为 n，则分子式 CnH2n+2。① let the number of carbons be n, so the formula is CnH2n+2.
12n + 1×(2n+2) = 44 14n + 2 = 44 14n = 42 → n = 3
② n = 3 → 分子式 C₃H₈，名称是丙烷 propane。② n = 3 → the formula is C₃H₈, called propane.
练习Practice
先由氢数反推 n，再比较沸点。Work out n from the number of hydrogens, then compare boiling points.

某烷烃分子里有 16 个氢原子。(a) 求它的分子式；(b) 它的名称是什么？(c) 它的沸点比甲烷高还是低？为什么？An alkane contains 16 hydrogen atoms. (a) What is its molecular formula? (b) What is its name? (c) Is its boiling point higher or lower than methane's? Why?

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 2n+2 = 16 → n = 7 → C₇H₁₆。
(b) 7 个碳是庚烷 heptane。
(c) 更高——碳链更长，分子间力更强，需要更多能量才能分开。 (a) 2n+2 = 16 → n = 7 → C₇H₁₆.
(b) seven carbons means heptane.
(c) Higher — the longer chain gives stronger intermolecular forces, so more energy is needed to separate the molecules.
— 第 1 站完成 —— Stop 1 done —
2 烷烃的两类反应Two types of alkane reactions Combustion & substitution燃烧与取代
这一站要你会：写出烷烃完全/不完全燃烧的方程式，并能按「引发、增长、终止」三步描述自由基取代机理。Goal: write balanced equations for complete and incomplete combustion, and describe free radical substitution in the three steps of initiation, propagation and termination.
烷烃就两件大事。第一件是燃烧：像烧柴一样，烧得好（氧气足）出 CO₂ 和水，烧得差（氧气不够）出有毒的 CO 甚至黑烟碳。第二件是取代：像一场接力赛——UV 光是一声发令枪，把 Cl₂ 劈成两个带单电子的 Cl•（自由基）；这两个急切的选手去抢 CH₄ 里的氢，抢出一个 CH₃•；CH₃• 又去抢 Cl₂，循环往复，链式反应越跑越长；直到两个自由基撞在一起，比赛才收场。每一步都只「换个成员」，不破坏碳骨架，所以叫取代。Alkanes do two main things. First, combustion: like burning wood — burn it well (plenty of oxygen) and you get CO₂ and water; burn it badly (starved of oxygen) and you get toxic CO or even sooty carbon. Second, substitution: like a relay race — UV light fires the starting gun, splitting Cl₂ into two Cl• radicals, each carrying a single electron; these eager runners snatch a hydrogen from CH₄, producing CH₃•; that CH₃• then attacks Cl₂, and the chain reaction rolls on; only when two radicals collide does the race end. Each step just swaps one member without breaking the carbon skeleton, which is why it is called substitution.
两条反应路线：Two reaction routes:
  • 完全燃烧（氧气充足）：烷烃 + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O，放出大量热，所以是燃料。Complete combustion (plenty of O₂): alkane + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O, releasing lots of heat — that is why they are fuels.
    CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O
  • 不完全燃烧（氧气不足）：生成 CO（有毒）或 C（黑烟、碳颗粒）。Incomplete combustion (limited O₂): gives CO (toxic) or C (soot / carbon particles).
  • 卤化 = 自由基取代（free radical substitution），条件：UV 光。三步必须会写：Halogenation = free radical substitution, requiring UV light. Learn the three steps:
    引发: Cl₂ ─UV→ 2Cl• 增长: Cl• + CH₄ → CH₃• + HCl CH₃• + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl• 终止: CH₃• + Cl• → CH₃Cl （或 2CH₃• → C₂H₆）
配平是重灾区：完全燃烧先配 C，再配 H，最后配 O。自由基取代一定要写清每一步的「•」——忘了那个点，整个机理就错了。Balancing is the danger zone: for combustion, balance C, then H, then O. In free radical substitution, always show the dot «•» on every radical — drop the dot and the whole mechanism is wrong.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: In the initiation step, UV light breaks the Cl–Cl bond homolytically to form two chlorine free radicals, Cl•. These radicals then react with methane in the propagation steps to form chloromethane, and the reaction ends when two radicals combine in the termination step.
例题Example
写出甲烷与氯气在 UV 光下生成氯甲烷（CH₃Cl）的完整取代机理，并配平完全燃烧方程式。Write the full mechanism for the reaction of methane with chlorine under UV light to give chloromethane, CH₃Cl, and balance the complete combustion equation.
① 引发：UV 光把 Cl–Cl 键均裂。① initiation: UV light splits the Cl–Cl bond homolytically.
Cl₂ ─UV→ 2Cl•
② 增长：自由基接力，生成氯甲烷。② propagation: the radicals relay and form chloromethane.
Cl• + CH₄ → CH₃• + HCl CH₃• + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl•
③ 终止：两个自由基结合。总反应 CH₄ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + HCl；燃烧配平 CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O。③ termination: two radicals combine. Overall CH₄ + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + HCl; combustion balances as CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O.
练习Practice
乙烷 C₂H₆ 同理，注意生成的是乙基自由基 C₂H₅•。Ethane C₂H₆ works the same way — note the ethyl radical C₂H₅•.

(a) 配平乙烷的完全燃烧方程式。(b) 写出乙烷与溴在 UV 光下的引发步骤。(a) Balance the equation for the complete combustion of ethane. (b) Write the initiation step for ethane reacting with bromine under UV light.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 2C₂H₆ + 7O₂ → 4CO₂ + 6H₂O（先配 C，再配 H=6，最后配 O=7）。
(b) Br₂ ─UV→ 2Br•——引发步骤永远是「卤素被 UV 均裂成两个自由基」。 (a) 2C₂H₆ + 7O₂ → 4CO₂ + 6H₂O (balance C first, then H = 6, then O = 7).
(b) Br₂ ─UV→ 2Br• — the initiation step is always "the halogen is split homolytically by UV into two radicals".
— 第 2 站完成 —— Stop 2 done —
3 裂化：把大分子切小Cracking: cutting big molecules Cracking裂化
这一站要你会：说出裂化的目的与条件，记住产物是「短链烷烃 + 烯烃」，并会写一个具体的裂化方程式。Goal: state the purpose and conditions of cracking, remember the products are "short alkane + alkene", and write a specific cracking equation.
裂化就像把一整串烤肠剪成小段卖：大段没人要，小段才好卖。石油里挖出的重油，碳链太长、太黏，需求很少；于是把它加热，再请催化剂（氧化铝/硅石）帮忙，把长链「咔嚓」剪断。剪断后一段碳数少、正好能当汽油（短链烷烃）；另一段因为碳的手突然少了一个邻居，氢配不齐，只能让两个碳互相多勾一下、挤出个双键——于是烯烃出现了，而烯烃恰恰是化工最抢手的原料。Cracking is like cutting a long string of sausages into small pieces to sell: nobody wants the big piece, the small ones sell. Heavy oil from petroleum has chains that are too long and too sticky, with little demand, so we heat it and ask a catalyst (aluminium oxide / silica) for help, snipping the chain in two. One piece is shorter — just right for petrol (a short alkane); the other has lost a neighbour, can't find enough hydrogen, and so two carbons grab each other twice, sprouting a double bond — and that alkene is exactly the raw material the chemical industry wants most.
必须记牢的四点：Four points to learn:
  • 定义：长链烷烃 →（加热 / 催化剂）→ 短链烷烃 + 烯烃。Definition: long-chain alkane → (heat / catalyst) → shorter alkane + alkene.
  • 催化裂化用氧化铝 / 硅石（aluminium oxide / silica）做催化剂，温度高。Catalytic cracking uses aluminium oxide / silica as the catalyst, at high temperature.
  • 目的：把需求少的重油变成汽油，同时供应工业急需的烯烃原料。Purpose: turn low-demand heavy oil into petrol, while supplying the alkenes that industry urgently needs.
  • 典型例子：Typical example:
    C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄
记住一句话：裂化产物一定含烯烃——因为断链之后氢原子配不齐，必然出现双键。看到「产物只有烷烃」的选项，直接排除。One sentence to remember: cracking always produces an alkene — after the chain breaks, the hydrogens can't balance, so a double bond must appear. Any option saying "alkanes only" is wrong.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Cracking breaks long-chain alkanes into shorter alkanes and alkenes, using heat and a catalyst such as aluminium oxide. It converts less useful heavy fractions into petrol and produces alkenes as a raw material.
例题Example
写出 C₁₀H₂₂ 裂化的一个可能方程式，并指出哪个产物是烯烃。Write one possible equation for the cracking of C₁₀H₂₂, and state which product is the alkene.
① 把 10 个碳拆成两部分，比如 8 + 2。① split the ten carbons into two parts, say 8 + 2.
C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄
② 检查原子守恒：C 8+2=10 ✓，H 18+4=22 ✓。C₂H₄（乙烯）是烯烃——通式 CₙH₂ₙ 就是烯烃的标志。② check the atoms: C 8+2=10 ✓, H 18+4=22 ✓. C₂H₄ (ethene) is the alkene — its CₙH₂ₙ formula is the alkene giveaway.
练习Practice
用「原子守恒」反推未知产物，先定碳数。Use atom conservation to find the unknown product — fix the carbon count first.

C₁₅H₃₂ 裂化生成 C₁₂H₂₆ 和一种烯烃。(a) 求该烯烃的分子式；(b) 说出这种烯烃的名称。C₁₅H₃₂ cracks to give C₁₂H₂₆ and an alkene. (a) Find the formula of the alkene. (b) Name it.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 碳：15 − 12 = 3；氢：32 − 26 = 6 → 烯烃是 C₃H₆。
(b) 3 个碳的烯烃是丙烯 propene（通式 CₙH₂ₙ，3×2=6 个氢，吻合）。 (a) carbon: 15 − 12 = 3; hydrogen: 32 − 26 = 6 → the alkene is C₃H₆.
(b) a three-carbon alkene is propene (formula CₙH₂ₙ gives 6 hydrogens, which fits).
— 第 3 站完成 —— Stop 3 done —
4 烯烃与 π 键Alkenes and the pi bond C=C double bond碳碳双键
这一站要你会：写出烯烃通式 CnH2n，解释双键结构（1σ + 1π）、为什么能发生亲电加成，以及为什么不能旋转导致顺反异构。Goal: write the alkene formula CnH2n, explain the double bond (1σ + 1π), why alkenes undergo electrophilic addition, and why no rotation leads to cis-trans isomerism.
σ 键像两根球棍之间的实心焊点，牢牢待在两个碳的连线上；π 键则像这条连线上下飘着的两片电子云，比较松散、暴露在外面。所以烯烃的「软肋」就是这条 π 键——谁缺电子（亲电试剂），都想凑过来捅一下，把双键拆开、各自霸占一个碳，这就是亲电加成。又因为双键把两个碳锁在同一个平面里，不能像单键那样随便转，于是两个碳上的基团有了「同侧（顺）/异侧（反）」之分，这就是顺反异构。The σ bond is like a solid weld between two sticks, sitting firmly on the line joining the carbons; the π bond is like two clouds of electrons drifting above and below that line, loose and exposed. That π bond is the alkene's weak spot — anything electron-poor (an electrophile) wants to stab at it, breaking the double bond open and grabbing a carbon each: that is electrophilic addition. And because the double bond locks the two carbons into one plane, they can't rotate like a single bond can, so the groups on the two carbons come in "same side (cis)" and "opposite side (trans)" versions — that is cis-trans isomerism.
必须记牢的四点：Four points to learn:
  • 通式：CnH2n（比同碳数的烷烃少 2 个氢）。General formula: CnH2n (two hydrogens fewer than the alkane with the same number of carbons).
  • C=C 双键 = 1 条 σ 键 + 1 条 π 键。The C=C double bond = one σ bond + one π bond.
  • π 键电子云暴露 → 容易被亲电试剂攻击 → 发生亲电加成。The π cloud is exposed → easily attacked by electrophiles → electrophilic addition.
  • 双键是平面结构、不能旋转 → 产生顺反异构（cis-trans isomerism）。The double bond is planar and cannot rotate → giving cis-trans isomerism.
顺反异构有条件：每个双键碳上连的两个基团必须不同。像 CH₂=CH₂ 这种一端全是氢的，没有顺反异构——别见双键就喊 cis-trans。Cis-trans has a condition: each double-bonded carbon must carry two different groups. Something like CH₂=CH₂, with two hydrogens on one carbon, has no cis-trans isomer — don't shout "cis-trans" at every double bond.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The carbon-carbon double bond consists of one sigma bond and one pi bond. The pi bond is weaker and its electron cloud is exposed, so alkenes undergo electrophilic addition. The double bond cannot rotate, which leads to cis-trans isomerism when each carbon carries two different groups.
例题Example
判断下列分子哪个有顺反异构：CH₂=CH₂ 和 CH₃CH=CHCH₃。Which of these has cis-trans isomerism: CH₂=CH₂ or CH₃CH=CHCH₃?
① CH₂=CH₂：两个双键碳上都是「H 和 H」，基团相同 → 没有顺反异构。① CH₂=CH₂: each double-bonded carbon carries "H and H", the same group → no cis-trans isomerism. ② CH₃CH=CHCH₃：每个双键碳上连「CH₃ 和 H」，两个基团不同 → 有顺反异构（顺-2-丁烯 与 反-2-丁烯）。② CH₃CH=CHCH₃: each double-bonded carbon carries "CH₃ and H", two different groups → yes (cis- and trans-but-2-ene).
练习Practice
只看双键那两个碳各自连的两个基团一不一样。Only check the two groups attached to each double-bonded carbon.

CH₃CH=CHCH₂CH₃（戊-2-烯）有顺反异构吗？说明理由。Does CH₃CH=CHCH₂CH₃ (pent-2-ene) have cis-trans isomerism? Explain.

点开看答案Show answer
有。左边双键碳连「H 和 CH₃」（不同），右边双键碳连「H 和 CH₂CH₃」（不同），两个碳都满足「两基团不同」的条件，所以存在顺反异构。 Yes. The left double-bonded carbon carries "H and CH₃" (different) and the right one carries "H and CH₂CH₃" (different), so both carbons meet the "two different groups" condition, and cis-trans isomerism exists.
— 第 4 站完成 —— Stop 4 done —
5 亲电加成四连Four electrophilic additions Electrophilic addition亲电加成
这一站要你会：写出四种加成反应（H₂、Br₂、HBr、H₂SO₄ 后水解），掌握 Markovnikov 规则，并知道溴水褪色是检验双键的方法。Goal: write the four additions (H₂, Br₂, HBr, then H₂SO₄ followed by hydrolysis), apply Markovnikov's rule, and know that decolourising bromine water tests for a double bond.
亲电加成像闯空门的贼：π 键那两团暴露的电子云太诱人，缺电子的家伙（亲电试剂）扑上来，把双键拆开、各自霸占一个碳。四连就是四位常客：加 H₂（镍催化，把烯烃还原成烷烃）、加 Br₂（溴水褪色，检验双键）、加 HBr（遵守 Markovnikov：氢往氢多的碳上加）、加 H₂SO₄ 再水解（等于「加水」，变成醇）。Electrophilic addition is like a burglar breaking in: the exposed π cloud is too tempting, so an electron-poor species (the electrophile) pounces, breaks the double bond and grabs a carbon each. The four regulars: add H₂ (nickel catalyst, reducing the alkene to an alkane), add Br₂ (bromine water decolourises, testing for the double bond), add HBr (following Markovnikov: hydrogen goes to the carbon that already has more hydrogens), and add H₂SO₄ then hydrolyse (the equivalent of "adding water" to make an alcohol).
四连，一条都不能少：All four additions:
  • 加氢 +H₂：镍催化，把烯烃变成烷烃。Hydrogenation +H₂: nickel catalyst, turning the alkene into an alkane.
    CH₂=CH₂ + H₂ ─Ni→ CH₃CH₃
  • 加溴 +Br₂：橙色溴水褪为无色——检验双键的经典反应。Bromination +Br₂: orange bromine water decolourises — the classic test for a double bond.
  • 加溴化氢 +HBr：遵循 Markovnikov 规则——H 加到氢多的碳上，Br 加到氢少的碳上。Addition of HBr: follows Markovnikov's rule — H goes to the carbon with more hydrogens, Br to the one with fewer.
  • 加硫酸后水解：先加 H₂SO₄，再加水，相当于「加水」，生成醇。H₂SO₄ then hydrolysis: add H₂SO₄ first, then water — equivalent to "adding water", giving an alcohol.
Markovnikov 的本质：更稳定的中间体（碳正离子）是「取代更多的碳」——氢加在氢多的碳上，等于把正电荷放在取代多、更稳的那个碳上。记住「富的越富」。The heart of Markovnikov: the more stable intermediate (carbocation) is the more substituted carbon — putting H on the carbon with more hydrogens leaves the positive charge on the more substituted, more stable carbon. Remember: the rich get richer.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Alkenes undergo electrophilic addition. When hydrogen bromide adds to an unsymmetrical alkene, the hydrogen atom attaches to the carbon with more hydrogen atoms already attached, because the more substituted carbocation intermediate is more stable — this is Markovnikov's rule.
例题Example
丙烯 CH₃CH=CH₂ 与 HBr 加成，写出主产物并解释原因。Propene CH₃CH=CH₂ reacts with HBr. Give the major product and explain.
① 双键两端：CH₃ 端氢少，CH₂ 端氢多。① the two ends of the double bond: the CH₃ end has fewer hydrogens, the CH₂ end has more. ② Markovnikov：H 加到氢多的 CH₂ 端，Br 加到 CH₃ 端。② Markovnikov: H adds to the hydrogen-rich CH₂ end, Br to the CH₃ end.
CH₃CH=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃CHBrCH₃ （主产物：2-溴丙烷）
练习Practice
溴是对称加成，两个溴各加到一个碳上；想想观察到的现象。Bromine adds symmetrically — one bromine to each carbon; think about what you would observe.

丙烯 CH₃CH=CH₂ 与溴水反应。(a) 写出产物结构并命名；(b) 实验上会观察到什么现象？Propene CH₃CH=CH₂ reacts with bromine water. (a) Write the structure and name of the product. (b) What is observed?

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 两个溴各加到一个碳上：CH₂Br–CHBr–CH₃，名称 1,2-二溴丙烷。
(b) 橙色溴水褪为无色——这是含 C=C 双键（不饱和）物质的检验现象。 (a) one bromine adds to each carbon: CH₂Br–CHBr–CH₃, named 1,2-dibromopropane.
(b) The orange bromine water turns colourless — the observation that tests for a C=C double bond (unsaturation).
— 第 5 站完成 —— Stop 5 done —
6 加成聚合：做成塑料Addition polymerisation Polymerisation聚合
这一站要你会：写出聚合反应式（含 n），分清单体、重复单元、聚合度，并说出塑料的环境问题。Goal: write the polymerisation equation (with n), tell apart monomer, repeat unit and degree of polymerisation, and state the environmental problem of plastics.
加成聚合像开火车接龙：每个乙烯分子是一节车厢，双键是它伸出来的两只手，一打开就左右各拉住一个邻居，一节接一节，接成望不到头的长链。n 就是接了多少节（聚合度）。这条链太结实、细菌啃不动，所以塑料不可降解，埋进土里几百年都还在——这是它好用又招人恨的地方。Addition polymerisation is like a train coupling car after car: each ethene molecule is a carriage, its double bond is the two hands it offers, and once opened it grabs a neighbour on each side, carriage after carriage, into an endless chain. The n is how many carriages joined up (the degree of polymerisation). The chain is so tough that bacteria can't chew it, so plastics are non-biodegradable and stay buried in the soil for centuries — useful, but exactly why we hate them.
三个词，先分清：Three words to tell apart:
  • 单体（monomer）：聚合前的小分子，如乙烯 CH₂=CH₂。Monomer: the small molecule before polymerising, e.g. ethene CH₂=CH₂.
  • 重复单元（repeat unit）：链里反复出现的那一小段，如 –CH₂–CH₂–。Repeat unit: the small section that repeats along the chain, e.g. –CH₂–CH₂–.
  • 聚合度（degree of polymerisation）：一条链里重复单元的个数，用 n 表示。Degree of polymerisation: how many repeat units are in a chain, shown as n.
  • 反应式：The equation:
    n CH₂=CH₂ → –(CH₂–CH₂)ₙ– （聚乙烯 polyethene）
写重复单元别忘两件事：① 把双键打开，两个碳各伸出一根「连接线」；② 外面的 n 不能丢。常见的变体：聚丙烯 –(CH₂–CH(CH₃))ₙ–、聚氯乙烯 –(CH₂–CHCl)ₙ–。Two things when writing a repeat unit: ① open the double bond and give each carbon a dangling link; ② don't lose the n. Common variants: polypropene –(CH₂–CH(CH₃))ₙ– and PVC –(CH₂–CHCl)ₙ–.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: In addition polymerisation, many alkene monomers join together by opening their double bonds to form a long saturated chain called a polymer. Plastics such as polyethene are non-biodegradable, so they persist in the environment and cause pollution.
例题Example
写出丙烯 CH₂=CHCH₃ 加成聚合的重复单元。Write the repeat unit for the addition polymerisation of propene, CH₂=CHCH₃.
① 把双键打开：两个碳各伸出一根连接线。① open the double bond: each carbon offers one dangling link. ② 保留侧链 CH₃，得到重复单元：② keep the side group CH₃, giving the repeat unit:
n CH₂=CHCH₃ → –(CH₂–CH(CH₃))ₙ– （聚丙烯 polypropene）
练习Practice
氯乙烯 = 乙烯里一个 H 换成 Cl，侧链就是 Cl。Chloroethene is ethene with one H replaced by Cl — the side group is Cl.

氯乙烯 CH₂=CHCl 聚合生成聚氯乙烯（PVC）。(a) 写出聚合反应式；(b) 写出重复单元。Chloroethene CH₂=CHCl polymerises to polyvinyl chloride (PVC). (a) Write the polymerisation equation. (b) Write the repeat unit.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) n CH₂=CHCl → –(CH₂–CHCl)ₙ–。
(b) 重复单元是 –CH₂–CHCl–（把双键打开、两端各留一根连接线，侧链 Cl 挂在其中一个碳上）。 (a) n CH₂=CHCl → –(CH₂–CHCl)ₙ–.
(b) the repeat unit is –CH₂–CHCl– (open the double bond, leave a dangling link at each end, and hang the Cl side group on one carbon).
— 第 6 站完成 —— Stop 6 done —

单元 14 小结Unit 14 summary

① 烷烃只含单键（饱和），通式 CₙH₂ₙ₊₂；能干两件事：燃烧（完全出 CO₂ 和水，不完全出 CO/碳黑）和自由基取代（UV 光照下三步：引发—增长—终止）。
② 烯烃含 C=C 双键（1σ + 1π，不饱和），通式 CₙH₂ₙ；π 电子云暴露，所以发生亲电加成——加 H₂、Br₂（溴水褪色）、HBr（Markovnikov）、H₂SO₄ 后水解成醇。
③ 裂化把大烷烃剪成短烷烃 + 烯烃；加成聚合把烯烃连成塑料——一个在「切」，一个在「接」，正好相反。① Alkanes have only single bonds (saturated), formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂; they do two things: combustion (complete → CO₂ and water; incomplete → CO/soot) and free radical substitution (three UV-light steps: initiation–propagation–termination).
② Alkenes contain a C=C double bond (1σ + 1π, unsaturated), formula CₙH₂ₙ; the exposed π cloud drives electrophilic addition — with H₂, Br₂ (bromine water decolourises), HBr (Markovnikov) and H₂SO₄ then hydrolysis to an alcohol.
③ Cracking snips big alkanes into shorter alkanes + alkenes; addition polymerisation joins alkenes into plastics — one cuts, the other joins, exact opposites.

下一站最重要的一件事：把烯烃的「双键」换成卤素或羟基，就进入了卤代烃与醇的世界——它们能继续发生取代、消除和氧化，是单元 15 的主题。Why the next unit matters: swap the alkene's "double bond" for a halogen or an –OH group and you enter the world of halogenoalkanes and alcohols, which go on to substitute, eliminate and oxidise — the subject of Unit 15.

单元 15 · 卤代烃与醇：两个官能团的「换装」与「升级」Unit 15 · Halogenoalkanes and alcohols: two functional groups

  2. 亲核取代：SN1 与 SN2Nucleophilic substitution: SN1 and SN2

建议：先把第 1、2 站「带 δ+ 的碳被亲核试剂进攻」这个画面看明白，后面第 3 站的水解速率、第 6 站的氧化就能顺下来。Tip: get stops 1 and 2 clear first — the picture of a nucleophile attacking a δ+ carbon unlocks everything else.

1 卤代烃：分类与命名Halogenoalkanes: types and naming Classification & naming分类与命名
这一站要你会：写出卤代烃的通式 R–X，按「连卤素的碳上还有几个碳」把卤代烃分成伯/仲/叔三类，并能写出 1-bromopropane、2-chloropropane 这类命名。Goal: write the general formula R–X, classify halogenoalkanes as primary / secondary / tertiary by how many carbons the halogen-bearing carbon holds, and name compounds like 1-bromopropane and 2-chloropropane.
卤代烃，说白了就是烷烃里几个氢被卤素顶了岗。把它想成一串糖葫芦：原来每个竹签位上都插着一颗「氢」山楂，现在有一颗换成了更沉、更抢电子的「卤素」山楂。被换位置的那根竹签（碳）就成了全场焦点——考试问的「伯 / 仲 / 叔」，就是数这根碳上还串着几根别的竹签（几个碳）。A halogenoalkane is simply an alkane with some hydrogens replaced by halogens. Picture a stick of candied fruit: each slot used to hold a "hydrogen" fruit, and now one slot holds a heavier, greedier "halogen" fruit. The stick (carbon) that got swapped becomes the focus — and the "primary / secondary / tertiary" question is just counting how many other sticks (carbons) are attached to it.
必须记牢的四点：The four points to learn:
  • 通式 R–X，其中 X = F、Cl、Br、I。General formula R–X, where X = F, Cl, Br or I.
  • 分类看「承载 X 的那个碳」：它还连着 1 个碳 → 伯 primary；2 个 → 仲 secondary；3 个 → 叔 tertiary。Classify by the carbon holding X: attached to 1 carbon → primary; 2 → secondary; 3 → tertiary.
  • 命名：卤素作前缀 bromo-、chloro-、iodo-，给主链编号让卤素位号最小。例如 1-bromopropane、2-chloropropane。Naming: use prefixes bromo-, chloro-, iodo-, numbering so the halogen gets the lowest number. E.g. 1-bromopropane, 2-chloropropane.
  • C–X 键有极性：卤素电负性大、拼命拉电子，所以碳带 δ+、卤素带 δ−——这正是下一站「亲核进攻」发生的根源。The C–X bond is polar: the halogen pulls electrons hard, so carbon is δ+ and the halogen is δ− — the very reason nucleophiles attack in the next stop.
最容易丢分的地方：命名时卤素写前缀 bromo- / chloro-，别写成 bromide / chloride——那两种是离子 Br⁻、Cl⁻ 的名字，写进有机物名字里会被扣分。The classic lost mark: use prefixes bromo- / chloro- for the name, never bromide / chloride — those are the names of the ions Br⁻ and Cl⁻, and they lose you the mark.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: A halogenoalkane is an alkane in which one or more hydrogen atoms have been replaced by halogen atoms. It is primary if the carbon bonded to the halogen is attached to one other carbon atom.
例题Example
把 CH3CH2CHBrCH3 里连溴的碳按伯/仲/叔分类，并给这个化合物命名。Classify the carbon bonded to bromine in CH3CH2CHBrCH3 as primary, secondary or tertiary, and name the compound.
① 先找溴：它连在第 2 个碳上。① Find the bromine: it is on carbon 2. ② 数这个碳还连着几个碳：左一个 CH3CH2–、右一个 –CH3，共 2 个 → 仲 secondary。② Count its carbon neighbours: one CH3CH2– on the left and one –CH3 on the right, so 2 → secondary. ③ 命名：主链 4 个碳 = butane，溴在 2 号位 → 2-bromobutane。③ Naming: four carbons = butane, bromine on C2 → 2-bromobutane.
练习Practice
把结构画出来，数那个碳上除了氯还连几个碳。Draw the structure and count how many carbons the chlorine-bearing carbon holds.

判断 2-chloro-2-methylpropane 里连氯的碳是伯、仲还是叔，并说明理由。Is the carbon bonded to chlorine in 2-chloro-2-methylpropane primary, secondary or tertiary? Explain.

点开看答案Show answer
那个碳连着 3 个甲基（CH3） → 是 叔（tertiary）碳。它除了氯之外还连 3 个碳，所以是 3°。 That carbon is attached to three methyl groups (CH3) → it is tertiary. Apart from chlorine it bonds to three carbons, so it is 3°.
— 第 1 站完成 —— Stop 1 done —
2 亲核取代：SN1 与 SN2Nucleophilic substitution: SN1 and SN2 SN1 & SN2亲核取代
这一站要你会：解释 OH⁻ 作为亲核试剂如何进攻带 δ+ 的碳；分清 SN2（伯、一步、过渡态）与 SN1（叔、两步、先成碳正离子）；知道仲的介于两者之间。Goal: explain how OH⁻ as a nucleophile attacks the δ+ carbon; tell SN2 (primary, one step, transition state) from SN1 (tertiary, two steps, carbocation first); and know that secondary sits in between.
亲核试剂 nucleophile 就是「喜欢正电荷的家伙」——它手里攥着一对孤对电子，专门去找缺电子的地方，比如 OH⁻。卤代烃里那个被卤素拖成 δ+ 的碳，正是它的目标。整个过程像抢座位：SN2 是从背后一把把溴推开、自己同时坐下，干脆利落、一步完成；SN1 是溴先自己走人、空出座位变成碳正离子，亲核试剂再慢慢坐下——分两步走。叔卤代烃有三个「碳小弟」撑腰，碳正离子坐得稳，所以偏爱 SN1。A nucleophile is something that likes positive charge — it carries a lone pair and hunts for electron-poor spots, like OH⁻. The δ+ carbon of a halogenoalkane is exactly its target. Think of it as musical chairs: in SN2 the attacker shoves the bromine off from behind and sits down at the same time — one clean step. In SN1 the bromine leaves on its own first, the chair empties into a carbocation, and the nucleophile sits down afterwards — two steps. Tertiary halogenoalkanes love SN1 because three carbon "helpers" keep their carbocation stable.
两个机理，一张表分清：Two mechanisms, one table:
SN2SN2SN1SN1
步数Steps一步（经过过渡态）one step (via transition state)两步（先成碳正离子）two steps (carbocation first)
最爱谁Prefers伯卤代烃（位阻小）primary (little steric hindrance)叔卤代烃（碳正离子稳）tertiary (stable carbocation)
中间体Intermediate过渡态transition state碳正离子carbocation
  • 亲核试剂 = 有孤对电子、被正电荷吸引的物种（OH⁻、CN⁻、NH₃）。A nucleophile is a species with a lone pair, attracted to positive charge (OH⁻, CN⁻, NH₃).
  • 结果一样：X 被 OH⁻ 取代，生成醇 R–OH。Same outcome: X is replaced by OH⁻, giving the alcohol R–OH.
  • 仲卤代烃介于两者之间，两种机理都可能，看条件。Secondary halogenoalkanes sit in between — either mechanism, depending on conditions.
高频采分句：「叔碳正离子更稳定，因为烷基有给电子诱导效应（+I），分散了正电荷。」背下来，解释题能直接套。The mark-grabbing sentence: "The tertiary carbocation is more stable because the alkyl groups have an electron-donating inductive effect (+I), which spreads out the positive charge."
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: A nucleophile is an electron-pair donor. In nucleophilic substitution, the nucleophile attacks the electron-deficient carbon atom, and the halogen leaves as a halide ion.
例题Example
为什么 2-bromo-2-methylpropane 与 OH⁻ 反应走 SN1，而不是 SN2？Why does 2-bromo-2-methylpropane react with OH⁻ by SN1 rather than SN2?
① 连溴的碳是叔碳（连着 3 个甲基）。① The bromine-bearing carbon is tertiary (bonded to three methyl groups). ② SN2 要亲核试剂从背后进攻，三个甲基把路挡死了（位阻太大）。② SN2 needs a back-side attack, but the three methyl groups block it (too much steric hindrance). ③ 所以 C–Br 先自己断，形成稳定的叔碳正离子，再被 OH⁻ 进攻 → SN1。③ So the C–Br bond breaks first to give a stable tertiary carbocation, which OH⁻ then attacks → SN1.
练习Practice
先判断连溴的碳是伯/仲/叔。First decide whether the bromine-bearing carbon is primary, secondary or tertiary.

1-bromobutane 与 OH⁻ 反应主要走哪种机理？用一句话说明原因。By which mechanism does 1-bromobutane mainly react with OH⁻? Give a one-sentence reason.

点开看答案Show answer
SN2。连溴的碳是伯碳，位阻小，OH⁻ 能从背后一步把它取代。 SN2. The bromine-bearing carbon is primary, so there is little steric hindrance and OH⁻ can substitute it in one back-side step.

3 水解速率怎么比Comparing rates of hydrolysis Rates of hydrolysis水解速率
这一站要你会：用 AgNO3 检验水解产生的卤离子，比较不同卤代烃/不同卤素生成沉淀的快慢，并给出「叔 > 仲 > 伯」「C–I > C–Br > C–Cl」的顺序与理由。Goal: use AgNO3 to detect the halide ion from hydrolysis, compare how fast different halogenoalkanes / halogens form a precipitate, and give the order "tertiary > secondary > primary" and "C–I > C–Br > C–Cl" with reasons.
想知道卤代烃水解多快，化学家有个聪明办法：水解会放出卤离子 X⁻，只要往试管里滴几滴硝酸银，卤离子立刻跟 Ag⁺ 结合成沉淀。谁出沉淀快，谁反应就快。这就像赛跑计时——发令枪一响，谁先冲到终点（先冒沉淀）谁就赢。结果很清楚：叔代烃跑最快，伯代烃最慢；同样都是伯代烃，带碘的比带氯的快，因为 C–I 键最弱、最容易断。To find out how fast a halogenoalkane hydrolyses, chemists have a neat trick: hydrolysis releases the halide ion X⁻, so add a few drops of silver nitrate and the halide instantly meets Ag⁺ to form a precipitate. Faster precipitate = faster reaction. Think of it as a timed race: the one that reaches the finish line (shows precipitate) first wins. The result is clear — tertiary is fastest, primary slowest; and among primary compounds, iodine beats chlorine because the C–I bond is the weakest and easiest to break.
三条结论，都要会写理由：Three conclusions, each with its reason:
  • 沉淀是什么：卤离子 X⁻ + Ag⁺ → AgX 沉淀（AgCl 白、AgBr 浅黄、AgI 黄）。The precipitate: halide ion X⁻ + Ag⁺ → AgX (AgCl white, AgBr cream, AgI yellow).
  • 同样卤素，比结构：叔 > 仲 > 伯——因为叔碳正离子最稳定，断键最省力。Same halogen, different structure: tertiary > secondary > primary — the tertiary carbocation is most stable, so the bond breaks most easily.
  • 同样结构，比卤素：C–I > C–Br > C–Cl——键能越往下越弱，越容易断。Same structure, different halogen: C–I > C–Br > C–Cl — the bond gets weaker down the group, so it breaks more easily.
别搞混：AgNO₃ 是「检验卤离子的试剂」，不是催化剂；水解反应还要用乙醇作溶剂，因为卤代烃不溶于水。Don't mix up: AgNO₃ is the reagent that tests for the halide ion, not a catalyst; the hydrolysis also needs ethanol as solvent because halogenoalkanes don't dissolve in water.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Tertiary halogenoalkanes hydrolyse faster than secondary, which are faster than primary, because the intermediate tertiary carbocation is more stable. Among the halogens, the C–I bond breaks most easily, so iodo compounds react fastest.
例题Example
室温下往三支分别装 1-iodopropane、1-bromopropane、1-chloropropane 的试管里加入 AgNO3 水溶液。说出出现沉淀的快慢顺序并解释。At room temperature, AgNO3 solution is added to three tubes containing 1-iodopropane, 1-bromopropane and 1-chloropropane. Give the order in which precipitates appear and explain.
① 水解断的是 C–X 键，键能越弱断得越快：C–I < C–Br < C–Cl（键能）。① Hydrolysis breaks the C–X bond; the weaker the bond, the faster it breaks: C–I < C–Br < C–Cl in bond strength. ② 所以生成 AgI、AgBr、AgCl 沉淀的速度：1-iodopropane 最快，1-chloropropane 最慢。② So the precipitates AgI, AgBr and AgCl form in this order of speed: 1-iodopropane fastest, 1-chloropropane slowest. ③ 顺序：C–I > C–Br > C–Cl。③ Order: C–I > C–Br > C–Cl.
练习Practice
一个比「结构」，一个比「卤素」，两个维度分开想。One comparison is about structure, the other about the halogen — separate the two.

比较 2-bromo-2-methylpropane 与 1-bromobutane 与 AgNO3 反应生成沉淀的速率，并解释。Compare the rates at which 2-bromo-2-methylpropane and 1-bromobutane form a precipitate with AgNO3, and explain.

点开看答案Show answer
2-bromo-2-methylpropane（叔）更快。它水解先形成稳定的叔碳正离子，断键更容易；而 1-bromobutane 是伯碳，只能靠较弱的驱动力慢慢水解。 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (tertiary) is faster. Its hydrolysis first forms a stable tertiary carbocation, so the bond breaks more easily, while 1-bromobutane is primary and hydrolyses more slowly.

4 醇：结构与物理性质Alcohols: structure and physical properties Structure & physical properties结构与物理性质
这一站要你会：说出醇的官能团 –OH 与伯/仲/叔醇的分类，并用氢键解释「醇的沸点比同碳数烷烃高得多、小分子醇易溶于水」。Goal: state the –OH functional group and the primary / secondary / tertiary classification, and use hydrogen bonding to explain why alcohols boil far higher than alkanes of similar size and why smaller alcohols dissolve in water.
醇，就是烃上安了一个 –OH 的把手。这个 –OH 能伸出「氢键」这只小手，去跟别的分子（包括水）互相抓住。所以同样四个碳，丁醇的沸点比丁烷高一大截——因为要把分子分开，得先掰断它们之间的小手。也正因为醇能跟水握手，小分子的醇（甲醇、乙醇）可以无限量地溶在水里，而只含 C 和 H 的烃类就不行。An alcohol is a hydrocarbon with an –OH handle attached. That –OH can reach out a "hand" called a hydrogen bond and clasp onto other molecules, including water. That is why butanol boils far higher than butane despite having the same four carbons — you must first break the little hands before the molecules can separate. And because alcohols can shake hands with water, the small ones (methanol, ethanol) mix with water in any amount, while plain hydrocarbons cannot.
四点，一条线串起来：Four points on one thread:
  • 官能团：–OH（羟基 hydroxyl group）。Functional group: –OH (the hydroxyl group).
  • 分类：看 –OH 所在的碳连 1 / 2 / 3 个碳 → 伯 / 仲 / 叔醇，跟卤代烃同一套逻辑。Classification: count how many carbons the –OH-bearing carbon holds — 1 / 2 / 3 → primary / secondary / tertiary, the same logic as halogenoalkanes.
  • 氢键：醇分子之间、醇与水之间，都能形成氢键。Hydrogen bonding: alcohols form hydrogen bonds both between themselves and with water.
  • 两个后果：沸点比同碳数烷烃高得多；小分子醇与水互溶。Two consequences: a much higher boiling point than alkanes of similar size, and good water solubility for the small alcohols.
「氢键」三要素别漏：氢连在 O / N / F 上、与另一分子的 O / N / F 的孤对电子之间。少说一个就丢分。Don't miss the three parts of a hydrogen bond: an H bonded to O / N / F, and a lone pair on another molecule's O / N / F. Miss one and you drop the mark.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Alcohols have higher boiling points than alkanes of similar relative molecular mass because they form hydrogen bonds between molecules. Smaller alcohols are soluble in water because they form hydrogen bonds with water.
例题Example
乙醇（C2H5OH，M≈46）的沸点是 78°C，而乙烷（C2H6，M≈30）的沸点是 −89°C。解释为什么差别这么大。Ethanol (C2H5OH, M≈46) boils at 78°C, while ethane (C2H6, M≈30) boils at −89°C. Explain the huge difference.
① 乙醇分子之间除了弱的色散力，还能形成氢键。① Between ethanol molecules there are not only weak dispersion forces but also hydrogen bonds. ② 氢键比色散力强得多，把分子拉得紧紧的。② Hydrogen bonds are far stronger than dispersion forces, holding the molecules tightly together. ③ 所以要把乙醇分子分开需要多得多的能量 → 沸点高得多。③ So separating ethanol molecules needs much more energy → a far higher boiling point.
练习Practice
抓住「能不能形成氢键」这个开关。Focus on the on/off switch: can it form hydrogen bonds or not?

乙醇能与水任意比例互溶，而己烷（C6H14）几乎不溶于水。用氢键解释这个差别。Ethanol mixes with water in any proportion, but hexane (C6H14) barely dissolves. Explain using hydrogen bonding.

点开看答案Show answer
乙醇的 –OH 能跟水分子形成氢键，所以和水互溶；己烷只有 C–C 和 C–H 键，无法与水形成氢键，所以几乎不溶。 Ethanol's –OH can form hydrogen bonds with water, so the two mix; hexane has only C–C and C–H bonds and cannot hydrogen-bond to water, so it barely dissolves.

5 醇怎么造出来How alcohols are made Making alcohols醇的制备
这一站要你会：写出乙烯水合与葡萄糖发酵两条制乙醇路线（含方程式与条件），并比较它们的纯度与原料是否可再生。Goal: write both routes to ethanol — hydration of ethene and fermentation of glucose — with equations and conditions, and compare their purity and whether the raw material is renewable.
造乙醇有两条路。第一条「化工路线」：拿乙烯和水，在酸催化下一拍即合，产物纯净、反应也快，但要消耗石油。第二条「老祖宗路线」：让酵母把葡萄糖慢慢发酵，像酿酒一样，原料是可再生的甘蔗、玉米，但产物里掺着水，想拿高纯度乙醇还得再蒸馏。两条路没有谁绝对更好，考试问的是它们各自的条件和优缺点。There are two roads to ethanol. The first is the industrial route: ethene and water click together under acid catalysis — fast and pure, but it burns oil. The second is the ancient route: yeast slowly ferments glucose, like brewing, using renewable sugar cane or maize, but the product is watery and needs distillation to reach high purity. Neither is strictly better; the exam asks about their conditions and trade-offs.
两条路，记全条件：Two routes, learn all the conditions:
乙烯水合: C₂H₄ + H₂O → C₂H₅OH (酸催化 H₃PO₄) 发　酵: C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂ (酵母)
  • 水合：纯度高、反应快，但原料乙烯来自石油，不可再生。Hydration: pure product, fast reaction, but the ethene comes from oil, which is non-renewable.
  • 发酵：原料（糖、植物）可再生，但产物浓度低（约 15%），需蒸馏提纯。Fermentation: the raw material (sugar, plants) is renewable, but the product is dilute (about 15%) and needs distillation.
  • 两条路线最终产物都是乙醇，只是代价不同。Both routes end in ethanol; only the cost differs.
两个易错点：① 发酵的原料是糖（葡萄糖），不是直接把「酒精」发酵出来；② 写方程式别漏了副产品 CO₂。Two easy mistakes: ① the fermentation raw material is sugar (glucose), not "alcohol" itself; ② don't forget the by-product CO₂ in the equation.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Ethanol can be made by the hydration of ethene with steam using an acid catalyst, or by the fermentation of glucose using yeast. Fermentation uses a renewable raw material but gives a dilute product.
例题Example
写出乙烯水合制乙醇的方程式与条件；再写出发酵法由葡萄糖制乙醇的方程式；并各指出一条路的一个优点。Write the equation and conditions for making ethanol by hydration of ethene; write the fermentation equation from glucose; and give one advantage of each route.
① 水合：① Hydration:
C₂H₄ + H₂O → C₂H₅OH　（酸催化 H₃PO₄，高温高压）
② 发酵：② Fermentation:
C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂　（酵母，无氧）
③ 水合的优点：产物纯、反应快；发酵的优点：原料可再生。③ Hydration's advantage: pure product, fast reaction; fermentation's advantage: renewable raw material.
练习Practice
方程式要配平，副产品 CO₂ 别漏。Balance the equation and don't forget the CO₂ by-product.

写出发酵法由葡萄糖制乙醇的完整方程式，并说明工业上生产高纯乙醇为什么常用乙烯水合。Write the full fermentation equation from glucose, and explain why industry often uses the hydration of ethene for high-purity ethanol.

点开看答案Show answer
C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂。发酵产物浓度低、含水，要蒸到高纯度很费能；而乙烯水合直接得到较纯的乙醇，更适合工业大规模生产。 C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂. The fermentation product is dilute and watery, so distilling it to high purity is costly, whereas hydration of ethene directly gives fairly pure ethanol, better for large-scale industry.

6 醇的氧化与还原Oxidation and reduction of alcohols Oxidation of alcohols醇的氧化
这一站要你会：用酸化的重铬酸钾（K2Cr2O7/H2SO4，橙→绿）判断醇的氧化产物：伯醇 → 醛 → 羧酸、仲醇 → 酮、叔醇不反应；并知道 LiAlH4 / NaBH4 能把醛酮还原回醇。Goal: use acidified dichromate(VI) (K2Cr2O7/H2SO4, orange→green) to predict products: primary → aldehyde → carboxylic acid, secondary → ketone, tertiary no reaction; and know LiAlH4 / NaBH4 reduce aldehydes and ketones back to alcohols.
醇能不能被氧化，关键看它 –OH 长在哪种碳上。想象一辆车的发动机：伯醇是「一档」，还能连续升两档（先变醛，再变羧酸）；仲醇是「二档」，只能再升一档（变酮）；叔醇已经是「顶配档」，没档可升了，氧化剂拿它没辙。检验这场反应有个直观信号：橙色的重铬酸钾一氧化别人，自己就从橙变绿。Whether an alcohol can be oxidised depends on what kind of carbon its –OH sits on. Picture a car's gears: a primary alcohol is in first gear and can shift up twice (first to aldehyde, then to carboxylic acid); a secondary alcohol is in second gear and shifts once more (to ketone); a tertiary alcohol is already in top gear, with nothing left to shift to, so the oxidising agent can't touch it. There's a handy visual signal: as the orange dichromate oxidises others, it turns from orange to green itself.
氧化层级，记牢：The oxidation ladder, learn it:
氧化剂: K₂Cr₂O₇ / H₂SO₄（酸化重铬酸钾） 橙 → 绿 伯醇 RCH₂OH → RCHO（醛） → RCOOH（羧酸） 仲醇 R₂CHOH → RCOR'（酮） 叔醇 R₃COH → 不反应
  • 伯醇 → 醛 → 羧酸：想只拿到醛，必须用蒸馏及时把醛移走；否则继续氧化成羧酸。Primary → aldehyde → carboxylic acid: to stop at the aldehyde you must distil it off as it forms; otherwise it keeps oxidising to the acid.
  • 仲醇 → 酮：酮没有可继续氧化的「抓手」，到此为止。Secondary → ketone: a ketone has no handle left to oxidise further, so it stops.
  • 叔醇不反应：没有可脱去的氢，重铬酸根保持不变（仍是橙色）。Tertiary does not react: it has no removable hydrogen, so the dichromate stays orange.
  • 还原（逆过程）：醛/酮用 LiAlH4 或 NaBH4 还原回醇。Reduction (the reverse): aldehydes and ketones are reduced back to alcohols by LiAlH4 or NaBH4.
实验题采分点：区分「伯醇 → 醛」和「伯醇 → 羧酸」靠分离手段——蒸馏收醛、回流到羧酸。只写「加热」不写手段，通常拿不满分。The experiment mark: telling "primary → aldehyde" from "primary → acid" comes down to the separation — distil for the aldehyde, reflux for the acid. Writing just "heat" without the method usually loses the mark.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Primary alcohols are oxidised to aldehydes and then to carboxylic acids; secondary alcohols are oxidised to ketones; tertiary alcohols cannot be oxidised. The orange dichromate(VI) ion is reduced to green chromium(III).
例题Example
用酸化重铬酸钾分别处理乙醇、丙-2-醇、2-甲基丙-2-醇，各得到什么？溶液有什么颜色变化？Acidified dichromate is used to treat ethanol, propan-2-ol and 2-methylpropan-2-ol. What is formed in each case, and what colour change occurs?
① 乙醇（伯醇）→ 先氧化成乙醛，继续氧化成乙酸；溶液橙→绿。① Ethanol (primary) → first to ethanal, then ethanoic acid; the solution turns orange→green. ② 丙-2-醇（仲醇）→ 丙酮（酮）；溶液橙→绿。② Propan-2-ol (secondary) → propanone (ketone); solution orange→green. ③ 2-甲基丙-2-醇（叔醇）→ 不反应，溶液保持橙色。③ 2-methylpropan-2-ol (tertiary) → no reaction, the solution stays orange.
练习Practice
先看每种醇是伯/仲/叔，再对号入座。Classify each alcohol first, then match it to the ladder.

设计一个实验，用酸化重铬酸钾区分三种同分异构醇：丁-1-醇、丁-2-醇、2-甲基丙-2-醇。Design an experiment using acidified dichromate to distinguish three isomeric alcohols: butan-1-ol, butan-2-ol and 2-methylpropan-2-ol.

点开看答案Show answer
分别加酸化 K2Cr2O7：丁-1-醇（伯）→ 先成醛再成羧酸（橙→绿）；丁-2-醇（仲）→ 酮（橙→绿）；2-甲基丙-2-醇（叔）→ 不反应（保持橙色）。若要再区分前两个，可用斐林试剂检验醛：只有丁-1-醇的中间产物乙醛能使斐林试剂变红。 Add acidified K2Cr2O7 to each: butan-1-ol (primary) → aldehyde then acid (orange→green); butan-2-ol (secondary) → ketone (orange→green); 2-methylpropan-2-ol (tertiary) → no reaction (stays orange). To tell the first two apart, test the product with Fehling's reagent — only butanal (from butan-1-ol) gives a red precipitate.
— 第 6 站完成 —— Stop 6 done —

单元 15 小结Unit 15 summary

① 卤代烃的核心是「带 δ+ 的碳被亲核试剂进攻」：伯走 SN2（一步），叔走 SN1（两步，先成碳正离子）。
② 醇靠氢键升高沸点、溶于水；造醇两条路——乙烯水合快而纯，发酵慢但可再生。
③ 氧化靠酸化重铬酸钾「橙→绿」：伯醇一路到羧酸，仲醇停在酮，叔醇动不了；醛酮还能被 LiAlH4 / NaBH4 还原回醇。① The heart of halogenoalkanes is a nucleophile attacking a δ+ carbon: primary goes by SN2 (one step), tertiary by SN1 (two steps, carbocation first).
② Alcohols use hydrogen bonding to raise their boiling point and dissolve in water; they are made two ways — hydration of ethene (fast, pure) or fermentation (slow, renewable).
③ Oxidation uses acidified dichromate, orange→green: primary alcohols go all the way to the acid, secondary stop at the ketone, tertiary won't move; aldehydes and ketones can be reduced back by LiAlH4 / NaBH4.

下一站为什么重要：卤代烃的「取代」和醇的「氧化」都不是终点——醇再往上氧化就是醛、酮、羧酸，这些含羰基 C=O 的化合物是单元 16 的主角，也是整个有机化学的「中转站」。Why the next unit matters: the substitution of halogenoalkanes and the oxidation of alcohols are not the end — oxidise an alcohol further and you reach aldehydes, ketones and carboxylic acids, the carbonyl (C=O) compounds that star in Unit 16 and act as the "junction" of all organic chemistry.

单元 16 · 羰基、羧酸与衍生物Unit 16 · Carbonyl compounds and carboxylic acids
