1 醛与酮：孪生兄弟Aldehydes and ketones: the twins Carbonyl group C=O羰基 C=O
这一站要你会：认出羰基 C=O，分清醛（末端 –CHO）与酮（中间 >C=O），并会命名 propanal、propanone 这类简单例子。Goal: recognise the carbonyl C=O, tell an aldehyde (terminal –CHO) from a ketone (internal >C=O), and name simple examples like propanal and propanone.
醛和酮就像同一对孪生兄弟，长得几乎一样（都有一根显眼的 C=O），区别只在「谁站在门口」：醛的 C=O 在链的末端，旁边还牵着个 H，像个站在队伍最后的人；酮的 C=O 被夹在中间，两边都是碳链。就因为这点位置差别，后面站里它们的「性格」（能不能被氧化）会完全不一样。Aldehydes and ketones are twins — almost identical (both have that prominent C=O) — the only difference is who stands at the door. An aldehyde puts its C=O at the end of the chain, holding on to an H; a ketone tucks its C=O in the middle, flanked by carbon chains. That tiny difference in position is exactly why their "personalities" (whether they can be oxidised) diverge in the next stop.
三个要点：Three points:
  • 羰基 C=O 是这一整单元的主角：碳和氧之间是双键，极性强。The carbonyl C=O is the star of this whole unit: a polar double bond between C and O.
  • 醛（-al）：C=O 在末端，至少连一个 H，通式 RCHO。例：CH3CH2CHO 叫 propanal（丙醛）。Aldehydes (-al): C=O at the end, at least one H attached, general formula RCHO. e.g. CH3CH2CHO is propanal.
  • 酮（-one）：C=O 在中间，两边都连碳，通式 RCOR′。例：CH3COCH3 叫 propanone（丙酮）。Ketones (-one): C=O in the middle, carbon on both sides, general formula RCOR′. e.g. CH3COCH3 is propanone (acetone).
命名最容易错的地方：酮有时要写位置号（比如 CH₃COCH₂CH₃ 要写 butan-2-one，因为羰基可能在不同位置）；但 propanone 不用写 2——三个碳的酮只有一个位置放得下 C=O，写了反而啰嗦。The classic naming slip: ketones sometimes need a number (CH₃COCH₂CH₃ is butan-2-one because the carbonyl could sit elsewhere), but propanone needs no number — a three-carbon ketone has only one possible spot for the C=O.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Both aldehydes and ketones contain the carbonyl group, C=O. In an aldehyde the carbonyl group is at the end of the carbon chain, whereas in a ketone it is in the middle of the chain.
例题Example
写出 CH₃CH₂COCH₃ 的名称，并说明它是醛还是酮。Name CH₃CH₂COCH₃ and state whether it is an aldehyde or a ketone.
① 找到羰基 C=O，它两边都连着碳（左边 CH₃CH₂–，右边 CH₃–），所以是酮。① Find the C=O; it has carbon on both sides (CH₃CH₂– and CH₃–), so it is a ketone. ② 数最长的碳链：一共 4 个碳 → 主链是 butan-，加酮的后缀 -one → butanone。② Count the longest chain: 4 carbons → butan- + the ketone suffix -one → butanone. ③ 羰基在 2 号碳（从近端数），所以全名 butan-2-one。③ The carbonyl is on C-2 (number from the nearer end), so the full name is butan-2-one.
练习Practice
先找 C=O 在末端还是中间，再数碳。First check whether the C=O is at the end or in the middle, then count the carbons.

(a) 写出 CH₃CHO 的名称，说明它是醛还是酮。(b) 写出 CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO 的名称。(a) Name CH₃CHO and say whether it is an aldehyde or a ketone. (b) Name CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) ethanal（乙醛）：C=O 在末端，连着 H，是醛。
(b) 4 个碳的醛 → butanal（丁醛）。 (a) ethanal: the C=O is at the end next to an H, so it is an aldehyde.
(b) a four-carbon aldehyde → butanal.
— 第 1 站完成 —— Stop 1 done —
2 怎么区分醛和酮Distinguishing aldehydes from ketones Tollens · Fehling · 2,4-DNP四种试剂
这一站要你会：针对「区分醛和酮」选对试剂，并写出对应的可见现象（银镜、砖红、橙黄、黄色沉淀各归谁）。Goal: pick the right reagent to tell aldehydes from ketones, and match each observation (silver mirror, brick-red, orange, yellow) to the correct reagent.
区分醛和酮，靠的是「谁能被氧化」。醛的羰基旁边多挂着一个 H，这个 H 很「容易被拿走」，所以醛能继续被氧化；酮两边都是碳，没有这个软肋，就动不了。于是能「抢走电子」的氧化性试剂——Tollens、Fehling——只对醛有反应。至于 2,4-DNP，它只认「有没有 C=O」，不挑位置，所以两个都反应，只能用来证明羰基存在，不能用来区分。Telling them apart comes down to who can be oxidised. An aldehyde carries an extra H next to its carbonyl — a H that is easy to take away — so aldehydes can be oxidised further; a ketone has carbon on both sides and no such weak spot. So oxidising reagents like Tollens and Fehling react only with aldehydes. 2,4-DNP, however, only looks for "is there a C=O?" and ignores the position, so it reacts with both — it can prove a carbonyl but cannot distinguish.
四种试剂，各司其职：Four reagents, four jobs:
  • Tollens（银氨溶液）：醛才反应，生成银镜（Ag⁺ 被还原成 Ag 镀在试管壁）；酮不反应。Tollens' reagent: only aldehydes react, giving a silver mirror (Ag⁺ reduced to Ag on the glass); ketones do not react.
  • Fehling（蓝色溶液）：醛才反应，蓝色 Cu²⁺ 变成砖红色 Cu2O 沉淀；酮不反应。Fehling's solution (blue): only aldehydes react, turning blue Cu²⁺ into a brick-red Cu2O precipitate; ketones do not react.
  • 2,4-DNP：醛和酮都生成橙黄色沉淀——它只告诉我们「有羰基」。2,4-DNP: both aldehydes and ketones give an orange precipitate — it only tells us a carbonyl group is present.
  • 碘仿（I₂ + NaOH）：对含有 CH3CO– 的分子（甲基酮，以及 ethanal）生成黄色 CHI3 沉淀。Iodoform test (I₂ + NaOH): molecules containing CH3CO– (methyl ketones, and ethanal) give a yellow precipitate of CHI3.
高频陷阱：题目问「怎么用化学方法区分 propanal 和 propanone」，答 Tollens（或 Fehling）就对了；但如果你答「2,4-DNP」，一分都拿不到——因为它俩都变橙黄，区分不了。The classic trap: asked to distinguish propanal from propanone, answer Tollens (or Fehling). But answer "2,4-DNP" and you score nothing — both turn orange, so it cannot tell them apart.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Aldehydes are oxidised by Tollens' reagent to give a silver mirror, and by Fehling's solution to give a brick-red precipitate, whereas ketones cannot be oxidised and give no reaction.
例题Example
实验室有两瓶无色液体：propanal 和 propanone。说出两种能区分它们的试剂，并各写一个可见现象。Two colourless liquids are labelled propanal and propanone. State two reagents that distinguish them and give one observation for each.
① Tollens 试剂：propanal 出现银镜，propanone 无变化。① Tollens' reagent: propanal gives a silver mirror, propanone shows no change. ② Fehling 溶液：propanal 变成砖红色沉淀，propanone 保持蓝色。② Fehling's solution: propanal gives a brick-red precipitate, propanone stays blue.
练习Practice
先想清楚每个试剂能测什么，再对号入座。Think about what each reagent detects, then match it up.

有一种化合物，与 2,4-DNP 产生橙黄色沉淀，但既不与 Tollens 反应、也不与 Fehling 反应。(a) 它是醛还是酮？(b) 再举一个能进一步确认其结构的试剂。A compound gives an orange precipitate with 2,4-DNP, but does not react with Tollens or Fehling. (a) Is it an aldehyde or a ketone? (b) Name one more reagent that would confirm its structure.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 酮——它含羰基（所以 2,4-DNP 出橙黄），但不能被氧化（所以 Tollens / Fehling 都不反应）。
(b) 碘仿试剂（I₂ + NaOH）：如果它含 CH3CO– 结构（甲基酮），会出现黄色沉淀；不反应则不是甲基酮。 (a) A ketone — it has a carbonyl group (so 2,4-DNP turns orange) but cannot be oxidised (so neither Tollens nor Fehling reacts).
(b) Iodoform reagent (I₂ + NaOH): if it contains a CH3CO– group (a methyl ketone) a yellow precipitate forms; no reaction means it is not a methyl ketone.
— 第 2 站完成 —— Stop 2 done —
3 亲核加成与还原Nucleophilic addition and reduction HCN · NaBH₄加成与还原
这一站要你会：写出 HCN 与羰基加成的产物（羟腈）、NaBH₄ 还原的产物，并画出「亲核试剂进攻 δ+ 碳」的弯箭头机理。Goal: write the product of HCN addition (a hydroxynitrile) and of NaBH₄ reduction, and draw the curly-arrow mechanism of a nucleophile attacking the δ+ carbon.
把 C=O 想成一个有磁性的双人沙发：氧更会抢电子，所以带 δ−；碳被抢了电子，带 δ+，像个空着的位置。亲核试剂（带负电、爱送电子的一类）就像急着入座的人，会直接朝 δ+ 的碳扑过去——这一坐，把 C=O 的其中一根「键」挤给了氧，氧就多了一对电子变成负离子。这个过程就叫亲核加成。Think of C=O as a magnetic two-seater sofa: oxygen hogs electrons and becomes δ−, while carbon loses out and becomes δ+ — an empty seat. A nucleophile (something negative that loves donating electrons) dives straight for that δ+ carbon; as it sits down, one of the C=O bonds is pushed onto oxygen, leaving oxygen with an extra lone pair and a negative charge. That is nucleophilic addition.
两条最重要的反应：The two reactions that matter most:
  • 加 HCN → 羟腈（hydroxynitrile）：羰基上同时接上 H 和 CN，碳链多长一个碳，是有机合成里「把链变长」的经典手段。Adding HCN → a hydroxynitrile: H and CN both join the carbonyl carbon, so the chain grows by one carbon — the classic way to lengthen a chain.
  • NaBH₄ 还原（代表 [H]）：醛 → 伯醇，酮 → 仲醇。只动 C=O，不碰 C=C。Reduction by NaBH₄ (a source of [H]): aldehyde → primary alcohol, ketone → secondary alcohol. It attacks only C=O, never C=C.
  • 机理的共同点：亲核试剂（CN⁻ 或 H⁻）的弯箭头指向 δ+ 的碳；同时 C=O 的 π 电子被推到氧上，氧带负电，最后被 H⁺ 中和。Same mechanism: the curly arrow from the nucleophile (CN⁻ or H⁻) points at the δ+ carbon, while the C=O π electrons are pushed onto oxygen; oxygen becomes negative and is finally neutralised by H⁺.
写方程式的死穴：HCN 加成后的产物要同时写对 OH 和 CN，而且命名常考：CH₃CHO + HCN → CH₃CH(OH)CN，叫 2-hydroxypropanenitrile。别把 CN 写了又忘 OH。The killer detail: the HCN product needs both the OH and the CN, and its name is often examined: CH₃CHO + HCN → CH₃CH(OH)CN, 2-hydroxypropanenitrile. Don't write the CN and forget the OH.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The nucleophile attacks the electron-deficient carbon atom of the polar C=O bond, and the π electrons of the double bond move onto the oxygen atom.
例题Example
写出 propanone 分别与 (a) HCN 和 (b) NaBH₄ 反应的有机产物，并写出 (b) 产物的类型。Write the organic product of propanone with (a) HCN and (b) NaBH₄, and state the type of alcohol in (b).
(a) 加 HCN：羰基碳接上 CN 和 OH → CH₃C(OH)(CN)CH₃（2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile）。(a) With HCN: the carbonyl carbon gains CN and OH → CH₃C(OH)(CN)CH₃ (2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile). (b) NaBH₄ 把酮还原成仲醇 → CH₃CH(OH)CH₃（propan-2-ol）。(b) NaBH₄ reduces the ketone to a secondary alcohol → CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ (propan-2-ol).
练习Practice
醛被还原成伯醇，酮被还原成仲醇——先看原料是醛还是酮。An aldehyde is reduced to a primary alcohol, a ketone to a secondary one — check the starting compound first.

(a) 写出 ethanal 与 NaBH₄ 反应的产物并命名。(b) 写出 butanone 与 HCN 反应的有机产物结构简式。(a) Write and name the product of ethanal with NaBH₄. (b) Write the condensed structure of the organic product of butanone with HCN.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 醛 → 伯醇：CH₃CH₂OH（ethanol）。
(b) 酮 + HCN → 羟腈：CH₃CH₂C(OH)(CN)CH₃，叫 2-hydroxy-2-methylbutanenitrile。 (a) aldehyde → primary alcohol: CH₃CH₂OH (ethanol).
(b) ketone + HCN → a hydroxynitrile: CH₃CH₂C(OH)(CN)CH₃, 2-hydroxy-2-methylbutanenitrile.
— 第 3 站完成 —— Stop 3 done —
4 羧酸：弱酸Carboxylic acids: weak acids –COOH羧基
这一站要你会：认出 –COOH、命名（ethanoic acid）、解释它为什么是弱酸，并写出它与金属、碳酸盐反应的方程式（都会放气）。Goal: recognise –COOH, name ethanoic acid, explain why it is a weak acid, and write its reactions with metals and carbonates (both fizz).
把 –COOH 想成一个舍不得放手的人：它确实能放出 H⁺（所以是酸），但放得很小气——大部分分子攥着 H 不放，水里只有一点点 H⁺ 跑出来。所以它导电差、pH 不像盐酸那么低，这叫弱酸。而 HCl、H₂SO₄ 那种是大方的强酸，一进水就把 H⁺ 全交出来。Think of –COOH as a stingy giver: it can release H⁺ (so it is an acid), but it does so reluctantly — most molecules hang on to their H, and only a little H⁺ escapes into the water. That is why it conducts poorly and its pH is not as low as hydrochloric acid's: it is a weak acid. HCl and H₂SO₄ are the generous strong acids that hand over every H⁺.
要记牢的：To memorise:
  • 官能团 –COOH（羧基）。命名把 -e 换成 -oic acid：CH₃COOH 是 ethanoic acid，HCOOH 是 methanoic acid，CH₃CH₂COOH 是 propanoic acid。The –COOH group. Replace -e with -oic acid: CH₃COOH is ethanoic acid, HCOOH is methanoic acid, CH₃CH₂COOH is propanoic acid.
  • 弱酸，部分电离：A weak acid, partially ionised:
    CH3COOH(aq) ⇌ CH3COO⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq)
  • 与活泼金属反应放 H₂（比盐酸慢）：2CH₃COOH + Mg → (CH₃COO)₂Mg + H₂。With a reactive metal it releases H₂ (more slowly than HCl): 2CH₃COOH + Mg → (CH₃COO)₂Mg + H₂.
  • 与碳酸盐反应放 CO₂：2CH₃COOH + Na₂CO₃ → 2CH₃COONa + CO₂ + H₂O（看到冒气泡就是它在冒 CO₂）。With a carbonate it releases CO₂: 2CH₃COOH + Na₂CO₃ → 2CH₃COONa + CO₂ + H₂O (the fizzing is CO₂).
  • 酸性排名：无机强酸（HCl、H₂SO₄）> 羧酸 > 酚 > 水/醇。羧酸比酚强，因为它的负离子更稳。Acid strength order: strong mineral acids (HCl, H₂SO₄) > carboxylic acids > phenol > water/alcohols. A carboxylic acid beats phenol because its anion is more stable.
容易丢分：写羧酸的电离要写可逆箭头 ⇌（弱酸不写 ⟶）。另外，与碳酸盐反应时，CO₂ 要写 (g) 冒出来，这是最常见的观测现象。Easy marks to lose: the ionisation of a carboxylic acid needs a reversible arrow ⇌ (weak acids never use ⟶). And in the carbonate reaction, write CO₂ with (g) — that fizzing is the most common observation asked for.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Ethanoic acid is a weak acid because it only partially dissociates in water, so the position of equilibrium lies well to the left, giving a low concentration of hydrogen ions.
例题Example
写出 ethanoic acid 与碳酸钠反应的完整方程式（含状态符号），并给出一个可见现象。Write the full equation (with state symbols) for the reaction of ethanoic acid with sodium carbonate, and give one observation.
2CH3COOH(aq) + Na2CO3(s) → 2CH3COONa(aq) + CO2(g) + H2O(l)
现象：冒气泡（CO₂），把气体通入石灰水会变浑浊。Observation: bubbles of CO₂, which turn limewater milky.
练习Practice
酸 + 碳酸盐 → 盐 + 水 + 二氧化碳，先把盐写对。acid + carbonate → salt + water + carbon dioxide; get the salt right first.

(a) 写出 propanoic acid 与镁反应的方程式。(b) 解释为什么 ethanoic acid 的 pH 比同浓度的盐酸高。(a) Write the equation for propanoic acid with magnesium. (b) Explain why ethanoic acid has a higher pH than hydrochloric acid of the same concentration.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 2CH₃CH₂COOH + Mg → (CH₃CH₂COO)₂Mg + H₂（放氢气）。
(b) 因为 ethanoic acid 是弱酸，只部分电离，溶液里的 H⁺ 浓度比完全电离的盐酸低得多，所以 pH 更高。 (a) 2CH₃CH₂COOH + Mg → (CH₃CH₂COO)₂Mg + H₂ (hydrogen is released).
(b) Ethanoic acid is a weak acid that only partially ionises, so its H⁺ concentration is much lower than that of fully ionised HCl, giving a higher pH.
— 第 4 站完成 —— Stop 4 done —
5 酯化与酯的水解Esterification and hydrolysis –COO–酯基
这一站要你会：写出醇 + 羧酸 ⇌ 酯 + 水的方程式，会命名（ethyl ethanoate），并说清「酸水解可逆、碱水解（皂化）不可逆」。Goal: write alcohol + acid ⇌ ester + water, name ethyl ethanoate, and explain that acid hydrolysis is reversible while base hydrolysis (saponification) is not.
做酯就像两个人牵手合影：醇出一个「–O–」，酸出一个「C=O」，合起来脱掉一分子水，就成了酯。这个牵手不牢靠——加水又能拆开，所以叫可逆。但如果你改用强碱（NaOH）来拆，碱会把生成的酸当场「吃掉」（变成盐），于是反应回不了头，只能一路走到黑——这就是做肥皂用的皂化。Making an ester is like two people holding hands for a photo: the alcohol contributes an –O–, the acid a C=O, and together they lose a molecule of water to form the ester. The grip is loose — adding water can break it again, so it is reversible. But split it with strong base (NaOH) instead, and the base instantly "eats" the acid (turning it into a salt), so the reaction cannot go back — it runs only forward. That is saponification, the reaction used to make soap.
要记牢的：To memorise:
  • 酯化（可逆，酸催化 + 回流）：醇 + 羧酸 ⇌ 酯 + 水。Esterification (reversible, acid-catalysed, reflux): alcohol + carboxylic acid ⇌ ester + water.
  • 例子：ethanol + ethanoic acid ⇌ ethyl ethanoate + water。Example: ethanol + ethanoic acid ⇌ ethyl ethanoate + water.
    CH3CH2OH + CH3COOH ⇌ CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O
  • 命名规则：前一半来自醇（ethyl…），后一半来自酸（…ethanoate）。所以 ethanol + ethanoic acid 得到 ethyl ethanoate。Naming: the first part comes from the alcohol (ethyl…), the second from the acid (…ethanoate). So ethanol + ethanoic acid gives ethyl ethanoate.
  • 酯有水果香——很多水果、香精的味道就来自小分子酯。Esters smell fruity — many fruit and perfume flavours come from small esters.
  • 碱水解（皂化）不可逆：酯 + NaOH → 羧酸盐 + 醇。油脂（三酯）皂化就出肥皂。Base hydrolysis (saponification) is irreversible: ester + NaOH → carboxylate salt + alcohol. Saponifying fats (triesters) gives soap.
可逆 vs 不可逆，别写反：酯化写 ⇌，酸水解也写 ⇌；只有碱水解用单箭头 →（因为碱把酸吃掉了，反应回不去）。Reversible vs irreversible — don't swap them: esterification and acid hydrolysis both use ⇌; only base hydrolysis uses → (the base removes the acid, so the reaction cannot reverse).
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: An ester is made by heating a carboxylic acid with an alcohol in the presence of a concentrated acid catalyst; the reaction is reversible. With sodium hydroxide the ester is hydrolysed irreversibly to the carboxylate salt and the alcohol.
例题Example
写出 methanol 与 ethanoic acid 生成的酯的名称和结构简式。Name and write the condensed formula of the ester formed from methanol and ethanoic acid.
① 醇出 methyl 部分，酸出 ethanoate 部分 → methyl ethanoate。① the alcohol gives "methyl", the acid gives "ethanoate" → methyl ethanoate. ② 结构：CH₃COOCH₃（酸在前、醇在后拼起来）。② Structure: CH₃COOCH₃ (acid part first, then the alcohol part).
练习Practice
先分清楚哪段来自醇、哪段来自酸。Work out which part comes from the alcohol and which from the acid.

(a) 写出 propanoic acid 与 ethanol 生成的酯的名称与结构。(b) 写出该酯与 NaOH 反应的有机产物。(a) Name and write the structure of the ester from propanoic acid and ethanol. (b) Write the organic products of that ester with NaOH.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) ethyl propanoate：CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₃。
(b) 碱水解出盐和醇：CH₃CH₂COONa（丙酸钠）和 CH₃CH₂OH（乙醇）。 (a) ethyl propanoate: CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₃.
(b) base hydrolysis gives the salt and the alcohol: CH₃CH₂COONa (sodium propanoate) and CH₃CH₂OH (ethanol).
— 第 5 站完成 —— Stop 5 done —
6 酰氯：最活泼的衍生物Acyl chlorides: the most reactive derivative R–COCl酰氯
这一站要你会：写出酰氯的制备（SOCl₂ / PCl₅）和它与水、醇、氨的三个反应（都生成什么 + 都冒 HCl 白雾），并知道它是「最活泼」的衍生物。Goal: write the preparation of an acyl chloride (SOCl₂ / PCl₅) and its three reactions with water, alcohol and ammonia (products + white HCl fumes), and know it is the most reactive derivative.
酰氯是羧酸家族里的急性子：把 –COOH 里的 –OH 换成一个 Cl，整个分子就像安了「快拆按钮」。它见水、见醇、见氨都立刻反应，而且反应又快又干脆（不用加热），还总是喷出 HCl 白雾。正因为它什么都肯反应，实验室用起来要小心——一开瓶盖，碰到空气里的水汽就开始冒烟了。An acyl chloride is the hothead of the carboxylic-acid family: swap the –OH of –COOH for a Cl and the whole molecule behaves like it has a quick-release button. It reacts instantly and cleanly with water, alcohol or ammonia (no heating needed), and it always puffs out white fumes of HCl. Precisely because it reacts with everything, handle it with care — open the bottle and it starts fuming with the moisture in the air.
制备 + 三个反应：Preparation + three reactions:
  • 制备：用 SOCl₂ 或 PCl₅ 把羧酸的 –OH 换成 –Cl。Preparation: SOCl₂ or PCl₅ replaces the –OH of a carboxylic acid with –Cl.
    RCOOH + SOCl₂ → RCOCl + SO₂ + HCl RCOOH + PCl₅ → RCOCl + POCl₃ + HCl
  • ＋水 → 羧酸：RCOCl + H₂O → RCOOH + HCl。+ water → carboxylic acid: RCOCl + H₂O → RCOOH + HCl.
  • ＋醇 → 酯：RCOCl + R′OH → RCOOR′ + HCl。+ alcohol → ester: RCOCl + R′OH → RCOOR′ + HCl.
  • ＋氨 → 酰胺：RCOCl + 2NH₃ → RCONH₂ + NH₄Cl。+ ammonia → amide: RCOCl + 2NH₃ → RCONH₂ + NH₄Cl.
三个反应共同的「签名」：都放出 HCl，现象就是白雾（可用湿石蕊试纸变红来验证是酸）。写方程式别漏了 HCl。The shared signature of all three reactions: they all release HCl, seen as white fumes (which turn damp litmus red, confirming an acid). Don't forget the HCl when writing the equations.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Acyl chlorides are the most reactive carboxylic acid derivatives. They react rapidly with water, alcohols and ammonia to give a carboxylic acid, an ester and an amide respectively, each reaction producing white fumes of hydrogen chloride.
例题Example
写出 ethanoyl chloride（CH₃COCl）分别与水、与乙醇反应的方程式，并指出共有的现象。Write equations for ethanoyl chloride (CH₃COCl) with water and with ethanol, and state the observation they share.
CH3COCl + H2O → CH3COOH + HCl CH3COCl + C2H5OH → CH3COOC2H5 + HCl
共有现象：放出 HCl 白雾。Shared observation: white fumes of HCl.
练习Practice
氨需要两份：一份进攻，一份把 HCl 变成 NH₄Cl。Ammonia is needed twice: one attacks, one converts HCl into NH₄Cl.

(a) 写出 propanoyl chloride 与氨反应的方程式（含有机产物命名）。(b) 为什么酰氯的制备与反应都要在无水条件下进行？(a) Write the equation for propanoyl chloride with ammonia (name the organic product). (b) Why must acyl chlorides be prepared and used under anhydrous conditions?

点开看答案Show answer
(a) CH₃CH₂COCl + 2NH₃ → CH₃CH₂CONH₂ + NH₄Cl，有机产物是 propanamide（丙酰胺）。
(b) 因为酰氯遇水立刻反应（水解回羧酸），水汽会把产物/反应物破坏，所以必须无水。 (a) CH₃CH₂COCl + 2NH₃ → CH₃CH₂CONH₂ + NH₄Cl; the organic product is propanamide.
(b) Acyl chlorides react instantly with water (hydrolysing back to the acid), so moisture would destroy the product or reactant — hence anhydrous conditions.
— 第 6 站完成 —— Stop 6 done —
7 一图串起整章The whole unit in one map Reaction map转换路线图
这一站要你会：把这单元的所有官能团串成一张转换图，说出每一步要用的试剂，并能设计一条 2–3 步的合成路线（Paper 4 的核心题型）。Goal: link every functional group in this unit into one map, name the reagent for each step, and design a 2–3 step synthesis (the core of Paper 4).
有机合成就像地铁换乘图：每一个官能团是一个「站」，氧化、还原、酯化、制酰氯这些反应是「线路」。拿到一个目标分子，你的任务就是在这张图上找出一条从原料到目标的最短路线。背下这张图，合成题就从「瞎猜」变成「查地图」。Organic synthesis is like a metro map: each functional group is a station, and oxidation, reduction, esterification and making acyl chlorides are the lines. Given a target molecule, your job is to find the shortest route from starting material to product on that map. Learn it, and synthesis questions stop being guesswork and become map-reading.
路线图上的关键「换乘」：The key transfers on the map:
  • 醇 ⇌ 醛 ⇌ 羧酸：向上是氧化（试剂写 [O]，如酸化重铬酸钾 K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺），向下是还原（NaBH₄）。Alcohol ⇌ aldehyde ⇌ acid: going up is oxidation (write [O], e.g. acidified K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺), going down is reduction (NaBH₄).
  • 羧酸 → 酯：加醇、浓硫酸催化、回流（可逆）。酯 → 羧酸：酸水解或碱水解（皂化）。Acid → ester: add alcohol, conc. H₂SO₄ catalyst, reflux (reversible). Ester → acid: acid or base hydrolysis (saponification).
  • 羧酸 → 酰氯：SOCl₂ 或 PCl₅。酰氯 → 羧酸/酯/酰胺：分别加水 / 醇 / 氨。Acid → acyl chloride: SOCl₂ or PCl₅. Acyl chloride → acid / ester / amide: add water / alcohol / ammonia respectively.
  • 做合成题的顺序：先数碳（碳骨架变了才用 HCN 加长），再看官能团怎么一步一步变过去。Order of attack in synthesis: count carbons first (use HCN only when the skeleton must grow), then plan how the functional group changes step by step.
两条「别走反」的提醒：① 醇→醛是部分氧化，要控制条件（蒸馏把醛及时拿走），否则醛会一路氧化到酸。② 制酯用羧酸 + 醇（慢、可逆）；想又快又干净，就用酰氯 + 醇——这招 Paper 4 常让考生选。Two "don't go the wrong way" reminders: ① alcohol → aldehyde is a partial oxidation — control the conditions (distil the aldehyde off), or it will run all the way to the acid. ② Making an ester from acid + alcohol is slow and reversible; for a fast, clean route use acyl chloride + alcohol — Paper 4 loves asking you to choose.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: To convert an alcohol to a carboxylic acid, oxidise it with acidified potassium dichromate under reflux. To convert the acid to an ester, react it with an alcohol in the presence of a concentrated acid catalyst, or use an acyl chloride instead.
例题Example
设计一条从 ethanol（CH₃CH₂OH）制备 ethyl ethanoate（CH₃COOCH₂CH₃）的两步合成路线，写出每步的试剂与条件。Design a two-step synthesis of ethyl ethanoate (CH₃COOCH₂CH₃) from ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH), giving the reagents and conditions for each step.
① 氧化：CH₃CH₂OH 用酸化 K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺ 回流，氧化成 ethanoic acid（CH₃COOH）。① Oxidise: CH₃CH₂OH with acidified K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺ under reflux → ethanoic acid (CH₃COOH). ② 酯化：把得到的 ethanoic acid 与（另取的）ethanol、浓 H₂SO₄ 一起回流 → ethyl ethanoate。② Esterify: reflux the ethanoic acid with (more) ethanol and conc. H₂SO₄ → ethyl ethanoate.
练习Practice
酯 = 醇 + 酸；先做酸，再让酸和醇牵手。An ester = alcohol + acid; make the acid first, then join it to the alcohol.

设计一条从 propan-1-ol（CH₃CH₂CH₂OH）制备 propyl propanoate（CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₂CH₃）的两步路线，写出每步试剂与条件。Design a two-step route from propan-1-ol (CH₃CH₂CH₂OH) to propyl propanoate (CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₂CH₃), giving reagents and conditions for each step.

点开看答案Show answer
① 把一半 propan-1-ol 氧化成 propanoic acid：酸化 K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺、回流。
② 让 propanoic acid 与另一半 propan-1-ol 在浓 H₂SO₄催化下回流酯化，得到 propyl propanoate。 ① Oxidise half the propan-1-ol to propanoic acid: acidified K₂Cr₂O₇/H⁺ under reflux.
② Esterify the propanoic acid with the remaining propan-1-ol using conc. H₂SO₄ catalyst under reflux → propyl propanoate.
— 第 7 站完成 —— Stop 7 done —

单元 16 小结Unit 16 summary

① 这一单元都在围着一个官能团转：羰基 C=O。醛（末端）和酮（中间）是它的两个「位置版本」。
② 区分靠氧化能力：醛能被 Tollens / Fehling 氧化（银镜、砖红），酮不能；2,4-DNP 只能证明有羰基。
③ C=O 的 δ+ 碳会亲核加成（HCN 加成长链、NaBH₄ 还原成醇）。
④ 往下是羧酸（弱酸）→ 再变 酯（可逆酯化 / 不可逆皂化）和 酰氯（最活泼，遇水/醇/氨都放 HCl 白雾）。
⑤ 最后把它们串成一张路线图，合成题就是「查地图」。① The whole unit revolves around one group: the carbonyl C=O. Aldehydes (at the end) and ketones (in the middle) are its two "positions".
② Telling them apart relies on oxidation: aldehydes are oxidised by Tollens / Fehling (mirror, brick-red), ketones are not; 2,4-DNP only proves a carbonyl is present.
③ The δ+ carbon of C=O undergoes nucleophilic addition (HCN lengthens the chain, NaBH₄ reduces to an alcohol).
④ Next come carboxylic acids (weak acids) → then esters (reversible esterification / irreversible saponification) and acyl chlorides (most reactive, fuming HCl with water/alcohol/ammonia).
⑤ Finally, join them into one route map — synthesis questions are just map-reading.

下一站最重要的一件事：这一章学的是含 C=O 的分子，而下一单元要讲含氮的有机分子（胺、氨基酸）和聚合物——其中酰胺就是这章「酰氯 + 氨」产物的亲戚。Why the next unit matters: this unit was all about C=O molecules; the next covers nitrogen-containing organics (amines, amino acids) and polymers — where amides are close relatives of this unit's "acyl chloride + ammonia" products.

单元 17 · 含氮化合物与聚合物Unit 17 · Nitrogen compounds and polymers

CAIE 9701 Topic 19、20 · 5 站 · 胺、腈，以及会「缩水」的聚合物CAIE 9701 Topics 19 & 20 · 5 stops · amines, nitriles, and the polymers that squeeze out water

路线图本单元五站，从「含氮的两员大将」走到「会缩水的聚合物」Five stops, from the two nitrogen players to the polymers that squeeze out water

  1. 胺：带氮的碱Amines: the bases with nitrogen
  2. 腈：多一个碳的入口Nitriles: the one-extra-carbon doorway
  3. 缩合聚合：缩出水来的塑料Condensation polymers that squeeze out water
  4. 氨基酸与蛋白质Amino acids and proteins
  5. 合成路线怎么设计How to design a synthesis route

建议：先把前两站（胺和腈）吃透——第 5 站的合成路线，就是把它们和前面学的醇、酸、酯串成一张网。Tip: nail the first two stops (amines and nitriles) — Stop 5 weaves them, with the alcohols, acids and esters you already know, into one network.

1 胺：带氮的碱Amines: the bases with nitrogen Amines胺
这一站要你会：认出 –NH₂（氨基），给伯胺命名（methylamine、ethylamine），并解释胺为什么有碱性、怎么制备。Goal: recognise the –NH₂ (amino) group, name primary amines (methylamine, ethylamine), and explain why amines are basic and how they are made.
把氨（NH3）想象成一个小木偶：三条胳膊各抓一个氢，怀里还揣着一只随时能抓东西的「空手」——那就是氮原子上的孤对电子。把其中一条「氢胳膊」换成一根碳链，就成了胺。因为那只空手还在，所以胺跟氨一样，见到氢离子（H⁺）就一把抓住，这就是碱性。Picture ammonia (NH3) as a little puppet: three arms each holding a hydrogen, plus one free hand tucked away — that free hand is the lone pair on nitrogen. Swap one hydrogen arm for a carbon chain and you get an amine. The free hand is still there, so amines grab a proton (H⁺) just as ammonia does — and that grabbing is what makes them basic.
必须记牢的四点：The four points to learn:
  • 胺是氨的衍生物：把 NH3 里的一个或多个 H 换成烷基。只换一个 H 的，叫伯胺（primary amine）。Amines are derivatives of ammonia: replace one or more H of NH3 with an alkyl group. Replace just one and you have a primary amine.
  • 命名 = 烷基名 + amine：methylamine CH3NH2、ethylamine CH3CH2NH2。Name = alkyl group + "amine": methylamine CH3NH2, ethylamine CH3CH2NH2.
  • 碱性来自孤对电子：氮上的孤对电子能接受 H⁺（形成配位键），所以「胺 + 酸 → 盐」。The basicity comes from the lone pair: it accepts H⁺ (forming a dative bond), so "amine + acid → salt".
  • 制备两条路：① 卤代烃 + 氨（取代，氨要过量）；② 腈还原（下一站讲）。Two ways to make one: ① halogenoalkane + ammonia (substitution, excess ammonia); ② reduction of a nitrile (next stop).
别手滑：不要把 CH3NH2 写成 CH3NH4——多一个氢就变成「铵离子」了；也不要把 methylamine 拆成两个词「甲基氨」，它是一整个词。Don't slip: writing CH3NH4 instead of CH3NH2 adds a hydrogen and turns it into an ammonium ion; and "methylamine" is one word, not two.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Amines are weak bases because the lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom can accept a proton (H⁺), forming a dative bond.
例题Example
写出 CH3NH2 与 CH3CH2CH2NH2 的名称，并解释为什么甲胺的水溶液能使石蕊变蓝。Name CH3NH2 and CH3CH2CH2NH2, and explain why aqueous methylamine turns litmus blue.
① 烷基名 + amine：CH3NH2 = methylamine（甲胺）；CH3CH2CH2NH2 = propylamine（丙胺）。① alkyl + "amine": CH3NH2 = methylamine; CH3CH2CH2NH2 = propylamine. ② 碱性：氮上的孤对电子接受水里的 H⁺，放出 OH⁻，所以显碱性、石蕊变蓝。② Basicity: the lone pair takes H⁺ from water, releasing OH⁻, so the solution is basic and turns litmus blue.
CH3NH2 + H2O ⇌ CH3NH3⁺ + OH⁻
练习Practice
命名套「烷基 + amine」；碱性想「孤对电子抓 H⁺」。Name with "alkyl + amine"; for basicity, think "the lone pair grabs H⁺".

(a) 命名 CH3CH2NH2。(b) 写出溴乙烷与过量氨反应制乙胺的方程式。(a) Name CH3CH2NH2. (b) Write the equation for making ethylamine from bromoethane and excess ammonia.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) ethylamine（乙胺）。
(b) CH3CH2Br + NH3 → CH3CH2NH2 + HBr。实际先生成盐 CH3CH2NH3⁺Br⁻，再由过量氨把游离的胺「顶」出来。 (a) ethylamine.
(b) CH3CH2Br + NH3 → CH3CH2NH2 + HBr. In fact the salt CH3CH2NH3⁺Br⁻ forms first, then excess ammonia releases the free amine.
— 第 1 站完成 —— Stop 1 done —
2 腈：多一个碳的入口Nitriles: the one-extra-carbon doorway Nitriles腈
这一站要你会：认出 –CN，给腈命名（ethanenitrile、propanenitrile），说出它由「卤代烃 + KCN」制得（增长碳链），以及水解得羧酸、还原得胺。Goal: recognise –CN, name nitriles (ethanenitrile, propanenitrile), say how they are made from a halogenoalkane with KCN (growing the chain), and that hydrolysis gives an acid while reduction gives an amine.
合成题最头疼的就是「碳链太短」。腈就是那个帮你接一节的入口：卤代烃的卤素被 –CN 顶掉，碳链立刻多一个碳。这个 –CN 后面可以水解成羧酸（–COOH），也可以还原成伯胺（–CH2NH2）——一条路通两头，而且两头都比原来多一个碳。The painful part of synthesis is a chain that is too short. A nitrile is the doorway that adds a link: the halogen is swapped for –CN, and the chain grows by one carbon at once. That –CN can later be hydrolysed to a carboxylic acid (–COOH) or reduced to a primary amine (–CH2NH2) — one route, two exits, both one carbon longer than the start.
四条要点：Four points:
  • 结构 –CN；命名时把腈基的碳算进主链，结尾加 -nitrile：CH3CN = ethanenitrile（2 碳），CH3CH2CN = propanenitrile（3 碳）。Structure –CN; when naming, count the nitrile carbon into the chain and end with -nitrile: CH3CN = ethanenitrile (2 C), CH3CH2CN = propanenitrile (3 C).
  • 制备：卤代烃 + KCN（乙醇溶液、回流）→ 腈 + KX。这是增长碳链的标准操作。Making one: halogenoalkane + KCN (in ethanol, reflux) → nitrile + KX. This is the standard chain-lengthening move.
  • 水解得酸：R–CN + 2H2O + H⁺ → R–COOH + NH4⁺（酸性水解）。Hydrolysis gives the acid: R–CN + 2H2O + H⁺ → R–COOH + NH4⁺ (acidic hydrolysis).
  • 还原得胺：R–CN + 4[H]（LiAlH4）→ R–CH2NH2（伯胺，也多一个碳）。Reduction gives the amine: R–CN + 4[H] (LiAlH4) → R–CH2NH2 (a primary amine, also one carbon longer).
命名最容易翻车：别把 propanenitrile 当成 4 个碳——腈基那个碳要算进去，所以 CH3CH2CN 是 3 个碳，叫 propanenitrile。数碳前先点一遍所有碳，包括 –CN 的那个。The classic naming slip: don't count propanenitrile as 4 carbons — the nitrile carbon is included, so CH3CH2CN has 3 carbons. Count every carbon, including the one in –CN.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: A nitrile is made by refluxing a halogenoalkane with KCN in ethanol. Hydrolysis of the nitrile gives a carboxylic acid, and reduction gives a primary amine; both contain one more carbon atom than the original halogenoalkane.
例题Example
以 1-溴丙烷（CH3CH2CH2Br）为原料合成丁酸（CH3CH2CH2COOH），写出两步所需的试剂与中间体。From 1-bromopropane (CH3CH2CH2Br), make butanoic acid (CH3CH2CH2COOH). Give the reagent and intermediate for the two steps.
① KCN（乙醇，回流）→ CH3CH2CH2CN（butanenitrile，丁腈）：碳链从 3 变 4。① KCN (ethanol, reflux) → CH3CH2CH2CN (butanenitrile): the chain grows from 3 to 4 carbons. ② 水解（H⁺/H2O，加热）→ CH3CH2CH2COOH（丁酸）。② hydrolysis (H⁺/H2O, heat) → CH3CH2CH2COOH (butanoic acid).
CH3CH2CH2Br →(KCN) CH3CH2CH2CN →(H⁺/H2O) CH3CH2CH2COOH
练习Practice
先看目标分子比原料多几个碳；多碳 → 用 KCN。Check how many carbons the target has gained; more carbons → use KCN.

(a) 命名 CH3CN 与 CH3CH2CN。(b) 写出 2-溴丙烷（CH3CHBrCH3）与 KCN 反应的产物，并说出该产物还原后得到什么。(a) Name CH3CN and CH3CH2CN. (b) Give the product of 2-bromopropane (CH3CHBrCH3) with KCN, and state what reduction of that product gives.

点开看答案Show answer
(a) CH3CN = ethanenitrile（乙腈）；CH3CH2CN = propanenitrile（丙腈）。
(b) 产物是 CH3CH(CN)CH3（2-methylpropanenitrile）；还原后得到 CH3CH(CH2NH2)CH3，是一个伯胺。 (a) CH3CN = ethanenitrile; CH3CH2CN = propanenitrile.
(b) the product is CH3CH(CN)CH3 (2-methylpropanenitrile); reduction gives CH3CH(CH2NH2)CH3, a primary amine.
— 第 2 站完成 —— Stop 2 done —
3 缩合聚合：缩出水来的塑料Condensation polymers that squeeze out water Condensation缩合
这一站要你会：说出缩合聚合与加成聚合的区别，认出聚酯（PET）与聚酰胺（nylon-6,6）的单体和键，并会写重复单元。Goal: state how condensation differs from addition polymerisation, recognise the monomers and links of polyesters (PET) and polyamides (nylon-6,6), and write repeating units.
加成聚合是「开门请进」——双键打开，单体一个个手拉手，谁也不少。缩合聚合是「每拉一次手就脱一件外套」——两个单体扣在一起时，旁边总会掉下来一个小分子，通常是水。掉水这个动作就是「缩合」，所以这种聚合物天生比它的单体「缩水」。Addition polymerisation is "open the door and come in" — a double bond opens and monomers join hands without losing anything. Condensation is "drop a coat at every handshake" — each time two monomers link, a small molecule (usually water) falls off. That shedding of water is the "condensation", so the polymer is literally lighter than its monomers.
三种聚合物要分清：Three polymers to tell apart:
  • 关键区别：缩合聚合的单体两端各有一个官能团；每接一个单体，掉一个小分子（H2O 或 HCl）。The key difference: condensation monomers have a functional group at each end; a small molecule (H2O or HCl) is lost at every link.
  • 聚酯：二元醇 + 二元酸 → 酯键 –COO–。PET 由 ethane-1,2-diol 与 benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid 制成。Polyesters: a diol + a dicarboxylic acid → ester link –COO–. PET comes from ethane-1,2-diol and benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid.
  • 聚酰胺：二胺 + 二酸 → 酰胺键 –CONH–。nylon-6,6 由 hexane-1,6-diamine 与 hexanedioic acid 制成（两个「6」得名）。Polyamides: a diamine + a dicarboxylic acid → amide link –CONH–. Nylon-6,6 comes from hexane-1,6-diamine and hexanedioic acid (the two "6"s give the name).
  • 写重复单元：只写最小重复的那一节，两端要留「伸出去的半根键」；水已经掉了，别写进重复单元。Writing the repeat unit: show only the smallest repeating section, leaving the half-bonds that continue outwards; the water has already left, so it is not part of the repeat unit.
最高频的两个错误：① 重复单元两端忘了留「续接的键」；② 把 H2O 写进重复单元里。水是「掉出去」的副产品，不在聚合物主链上。The two most common mistakes: ① forgetting the half-bonds at the ends of the repeat unit; ② writing H2O inside it. Water is a by-product that leaves — it is not in the polymer backbone.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: In condensation polymerisation, each time two monomers join, a small molecule such as water is eliminated. A polyester forms from a diol and a dicarboxylic acid; a polyamide forms from a diamine and a dicarboxylic acid.
例题Example
写出乙二醇（HOCH2CH2OH）与己二酸（HOOC(CH2)4COOH）形成聚酯的重复单元，并指出每接一个单体掉下什么。Write the repeating unit of the polyester from ethane-1,2-diol (HOCH2CH2OH) and hexanedioic acid (HOOC(CH2)4COOH), and state what is eliminated at each link.
① 找键：酯键 –COO–，由醇的 –OH 和酸的 –COOH 脱水形成。① Find the link: the ester bond –COO– forms when the –OH of the diol meets the –COOH of the diacid and loses water. ② 重复单元两端留半根键，外面套 [ ]n：② Leave half-bonds at the ends and wrap it in [ ]n:
[ –O–CH2CH2–O–CO–(CH2)4–CO– ]n 每形成一个酯键，掉下一分子 H2O
练习Practice
nylon-6,6 的「6,6」来自两个单体各有 6 个碳。The "6,6" in nylon-6,6 comes from the two monomers each having 6 carbons.

(a) nylon-6,6 由哪两种单体组成？各含几个碳？(b) 用一句话说出缩合聚合与加成聚合最根本的区别。(a) Which two monomers make nylon-6,6, and how many carbons does each have? (b) In one sentence, what is the key difference between condensation and addition polymerisation?

点开看答案Show answer
(a) hexane-1,6-diamine H2N(CH2)6NH2（6 个碳）与 hexanedioic acid HOOC(CH2)4COOH（6 个碳）。
(b) 缩合聚合每接一个单体掉一个小分子（如水），加成聚合什么都不掉。 (a) hexane-1,6-diamine H2N(CH2)6NH2 and hexanedioic acid HOOC(CH2)4COOH, each with 6 carbons.
(b) In condensation, a small molecule (such as water) is eliminated at every link; in addition, nothing is lost.
— 第 3 站完成 —— Stop 3 done —
4 氨基酸与蛋白质Amino acids and proteins Peptide bond肽键
这一站要你会：说出氨基酸同时含 –NH₂ 与 –COOH（两性），写出肽键 –CO–NH– 的形成，并理解蛋白质是氨基酸缩合聚合的产物。Goal: state that amino acids contain both –NH₂ and –COOH (amphoteric), write the formation of the peptide bond –CO–NH–, and see proteins as condensation polymers of amino acids.
氨基酸像一根「两头插座」：一头是氨基 –NH2（碱性），一头是羧基 –COOH（酸性），所以它既能当酸又能当碱——这叫两性。一个氨基酸的羧基和另一个氨基酸的氨基碰在一起，照样脱一分子水，连成 –CO–NH– 肽键。成千上万个氨基酸这样接起来，再折叠成型，就成了蛋白质。所以蛋白质本质上也只是一条长得惊人的缩合聚合物。An amino acid is like a two-ended plug: one end is the amino group –NH2 (basic), the other the carboxyl group –COOH (acidic), so it can act as both acid and base — it is amphoteric. When the carboxyl group of one amino acid meets the amino group of another, a water molecule is lost and a –CO–NH– peptide bond forms. String thousands of these together and fold them up, and you have a protein. So a protein is really just a condensation polymer of astonishing length.
四条要点：Four points:
  • 氨基酸通式 H2N–CHR–COOH；因同时有 –NH2 与 –COOH，显两性。General formula H2N–CHR–COOH; with both –NH2 and –COOH it is amphoteric.
  • 肽键 = 酰胺键 –CO–NH–：一个氨基酸的 –COOH + 另一个的 –NH2 → 肽键 + H2O。The peptide bond is an amide bond –CO–NH–: –COOH of one amino acid + –NH2 of another → peptide bond + H2O.
  • 二肽（两个）、多肽（许多个）、蛋白质（一条或多条多肽链折叠）。Dipeptide (two), polypeptide (many), protein (one or more folded polypeptide chains).
  • 蛋白质的形成也是缩合聚合：掉的还是水。Protein formation is also condensation polymerisation: water is still the molecule lost.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: Amino acids contain both an amine group and a carboxylic acid group, so they are amphoteric. When two amino acids join, a peptide (amide) bond –CO–NH– forms with the elimination of a water molecule.
例题Example
用通式写出两个氨基酸缩合成二肽的方程式，并把肽键指出来。Write a general equation for two amino acids joining to form a dipeptide, and identify the peptide bond.
H2N–CHR–COOH + H2N–CHR′–COOH → H2N–CHR–CO–NH–CHR′–COOH + H2O
肽键就是中间的 –CO–NH–：一个氨基酸的 C=O 连到另一个氨基酸的 N–H 上。The peptide bond is the central –CO–NH–: the C=O of one amino acid joins the N–H of the other.
练习Practice
甘氨酸 R = H，丙氨酸 R = CH3，套通式即可。Glycine has R = H, alanine R = CH3; just plug into the general formula.

甘氨酸 H2NCH2COOH 与丙氨酸 H2NCH(CH3)COOH 缩合。写出二肽的结构式并标出肽键；再解释氨基酸为什么显两性。Glycine H2NCH2COOH and alanine H2NCH(CH3)COOH condense. Draw the dipeptide, label the peptide bond, and explain why amino acids are amphoteric.

点开看答案Show answer
二肽：H2N–CH2–CO–NH–CH(CH3)–COOH，中间的 –CO–NH– 是肽键。两性：分子里同时有碱性的 –NH2（能接受 H⁺）和酸性的 –COOH（能给出 H⁺）。 The dipeptide is H2N–CH2–CO–NH–CH(CH3)–COOH, with –CO–NH– as the peptide bond. Amphoteric: the molecule has both a basic –NH2 (accepts H⁺) and an acidic –COOH (donates H⁺).
— 第 4 站完成 —— Stop 4 done —
5 合成路线怎么设计How to design a synthesis route Synthesis合成
这一站要你会：掌握「从目标分子倒推官能团、再找试剂」的思路，串起烯烃 → 卤代烃 → 腈/醇 → 醛 → 酸 → 酯的完整网络，并会做一道多步合成题。Goal: master the "work backwards from the target, then pick reagents" method, connect the full alkene → halogenoalkane → nitrile/alcohol → aldehyde → acid → ester network, and do a multi-step synthesis.
合成题要「倒着看地图」。别从原料往前硬猜，要从目标分子往回问：最后一步形成了哪个键？它由哪两个官能团变的？再往前追这个官能团又是从哪来的，一直追回题目给的原料。上面那张官能团转换图就是这张地图——大多数合成题都跑不出这张网。Synthesis questions are read backwards. Don't guess forward from the starting material; work back from the target: which bond is made in the last step? Which two functional groups form it? Then trace each functional group back until you reach the given starting material. The map above is exactly this map — most synthesis questions never leave it.
四步心法：The four-step method:
  • 倒推法：目标 → 上一步官能团 → 试剂与条件，一直回到原料。Work backwards: target → previous functional group → reagent and conditions, all the way to the starting material.
  • 必背试剂：烯烃→卤代烃加 HX；卤代烃→醇加 NaOH(aq)；卤代烃→腈加 KCN；醇→醛→酸用 [O]（K2Cr2O7/H⁺）；酸+醇→酯（浓 H2SO4 催化）。Reagents to memorise: alkene→halogenoalkane with HX; halogenoalkane→alcohol with NaOH(aq); halogenoalkane→nitrile with KCN; alcohol→aldehyde→acid with [O] (K2Cr2O7/H⁺); acid+alcohol→ester (conc. H2SO4 catalyst).
  • 长碳链靠腈（KCN）；变官能团靠氧化/还原。Lengthen the chain with a nitrile (KCN); change the functional group by oxidation/reduction.
  • 每写一步都「验票」：条件对不对、会不会伤到别的官能团、有没有更短的路线。At every step, "check the ticket": are the conditions right, will they damage other functional groups, and is there a shorter route?
采分点藏在这里：合成题常限制「最多几步」，还要求「写出每步的试剂与条件」。写试剂时把条件也写全——回流、催化剂、加热、水溶液还是乙醇溶液——这些就是分数。Where the marks hide: synthesis questions often cap the number of steps and demand "the reagent and conditions for each step". Write the conditions too — reflux, catalyst, heat, aqueous or ethanolic — those are the marks.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: To plan a synthesis, work backwards from the target molecule: identify the functional group, decide the reaction that makes it, and trace each intermediate back to the starting material, naming a reagent and conditions for every step.
例题Example
以乙烯（CH2=CH2）为唯一有机原料，设计合成乙酸乙酯（CH3COOCH2CH3）的路线，写出每步试剂与条件。Using ethene (CH2=CH2) as the only organic starting material, design a synthesis of ethyl ethanoate (CH3COOCH2CH3), giving reagents and conditions for each step.
① 乙烯 + H2O/H3PO4（水合）→ 乙醇 CH3CH2OH。① ethene + H2O/H3PO4 (hydration) → ethanol CH3CH2OH. ② 乙醇 + [O]（K2Cr2O7/H⁺，回流）→ 乙酸 CH3COOH。② ethanol + [O] (K2Cr2O7/H⁺, reflux) → ethanoic acid CH3COOH. ③ 乙醇 + 乙酸（浓 H2SO4，加热）→ CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O。③ ethanol + ethanoic acid (conc. H2SO4, heat) → CH3COOCH2CH3 + H2O. 倒推：酯 ← 酸 + 醇 ← 都来自乙烯；乙烯先水合成醇，一半氧化成酸，再把醇和酸酯化。Backwards: ester ← acid + alcohol ← both from ethene; hydrate ethene to the alcohol, oxidise half of it to the acid, then esterify.
练习Practice
目标比原料多 1 个碳 → 中间必走 KCN；酸由腈水解得。The target has one carbon more than the start → the middle step must use KCN; the acid comes from hydrolysing the nitrile.

以溴乙烷（CH3CH2Br）为原料合成丙酸（CH3CH2COOH），写出两步的试剂与中间体。From bromoethane (CH3CH2Br), synthesise propanoic acid (CH3CH2COOH). Give reagents and intermediates for the two steps.

点开看答案Show answer
① KCN（乙醇，回流）→ CH3CH2CN（丙腈，碳链从 2 变 3）。② 水解（H⁺/H2O，加热）→ CH3CH2COOH（丙酸）。 ① KCN (ethanol, reflux) → CH3CH2CN (propanenitrile; the chain grows from 2 to 3 carbons). ② hydrolysis (H⁺/H2O, heat) → CH3CH2COOH (propanoic acid).
— 第 5 站完成 —— Stop 5 done —

单元 17 小结Unit 17 summary

① 胺（–NH₂）有碱性——氮上的孤对电子抓 H⁺；腈（–CN）帮你长碳链——水解得羧酸、还原得胺。
② 缩合聚合每接一个单体掉一小分子（水）：聚酯＝二元醇＋二元酸（PET），聚酰胺＝二胺＋二酸（nylon-6,6）。
③ 氨基酸两性，缩合成肽键连成蛋白质——蛋白质也是一种缩合聚合物。
④ 合成路线靠「倒推」：目标 → 官能团 → 试剂，把那张官能团转换图刻进脑子里。① Amines (–NH₂) are basic — the lone pair grabs H⁺; nitriles (–CN) grow the chain — hydrolysis gives an acid, reduction gives an amine.
② Condensation loses a small molecule (water) at every link: polyesters = diol + diacid (PET), polyamides = diamine + diacid (nylon-6,6).
③ Amino acids are amphoteric; they condense through peptide bonds into proteins — which are just condensation polymers.
④ Plan synthesis backwards: target → functional group → reagent, and etch that functional-group map into your memory.

下一站，也是最后一个单元：单元 18 转到「光谱与分析」——不再动手合成，而是用红外、质谱这些仪器，反过来告诉你分子里到底藏着哪些官能团。合成与鉴定，正好是一个来回。The next, and final, unit turns to "spectroscopy and analysis" — instead of building molecules, you use instruments like IR and mass spectrometry to work out which functional groups a molecule actually contains. Synthesis and identification are the two halves of one round trip.

单元 18 · 光谱与分析：让分子自己报上名来Unit 18 · Analytical techniques: let the molecule introduce itself

CAIE 9701 Topic 22、37 · 6 站 · 看不见分子，就让它「自报家门」CAIE 9701 Topic 22 & 37 · 6 stops · you can't see a molecule, so make it tell you its name

路线图本单元六站，前 3 站学会「看谱」，后 3 站学会「用谱破案」Six stops — the first three teach you to read spectra, the last three teach you to solve structures with them

  1. 质谱：分子离子峰与 Cl/Br 指纹Mass spec: the M⁺ peak and Cl/Br fingerprints
  2. 红外光谱：分子振动暴露官能团IR: vibrations reveal functional groups
  3. 红外谱怎么读：先找 C=O 与 O–HReading IR: C=O and O–H first
  4. 碳谱 ¹³C NMR：数碳环境¹³C NMR: counting carbon environments
  5. 氢谱 ¹H NMR：位移、面积、裂分¹H NMR: shift, area, splitting
  6. 三谱合一：像侦探一样推出结构Combining evidence: deduce the structure

建议：第 6 站是前三样仪器的「合体」，先把前 5 站逐个看懂再回来，会顺很多。Tip: stop 6 combines the first three instruments — get stops 1 to 5 clear first and it will feel much easier.

1 质谱里的指纹：M⁺ 峰与同位素双峰Mass spec fingerprints: M⁺ and isotope pairs Mass spectrometry质谱
这一站要你会：指出分子离子峰并读出相对分子质量 Mr，还能从 M : M+2 的峰高比判断分子里有没有 Cl 或 Br。Goal: identify the molecular ion peak and read off Mr, and use the M : M+2 height ratio to tell whether the molecule contains Cl or Br.
质谱给分子拍一张「体重指纹照」：分子被夺走一个电子变成 M⁺，留下的那根「整分子」的柱子，位置直接告诉你它的体重（相对分子质量）。有些元素的原子有胖瘦两个版本（同位素），最出名的就是氯和溴——它们的同位素峰就像指纹上固定的两条纹路，看到特定的峰高比，你就知道分子里藏着 Cl 还是 Br。A mass spectrum is a fingerprint of the molecule's weight: the molecule loses one electron to become M⁺, and the "whole molecule" bar left behind tells you its mass (relative molecular mass). Some elements have heavier and lighter versions (isotopes) — chlorine and bromine are the famous ones. Their isotope peaks are like fixed lines in a fingerprint: see the right height ratio and you know whether Cl or Br is hiding inside.
三句必记：Three things to remember:
  • 分子离子峰 M⁺：整个分子失 1 个电子形成。它的 m/z 就是相对分子质量 Mr（一般是谱里 m/z 最大的那根）。Molecular ion peak M⁺: formed when the whole molecule loses one electron. Its m/z is the relative molecular mass Mr (usually the peak with the largest m/z).
  • 含 Cl 的分子：会出现 M 与 M+2 两根峰，高度约 3 : 1（因为 ³⁵Cl 占 75%、³⁷Cl 占 25%）。A molecule with Cl: shows M and M+2 peaks about 3 : 1 (since ³⁵Cl is 75% and ³⁷Cl is 25%).
  • 含 Br 的分子：M 与 M+2 两根峰高度几乎 1 : 1（⁷⁹Br 与 ⁸¹Br 各约 50%）。A molecule with Br: M and M+2 peaks are almost 1 : 1 (⁷⁹Br and ⁸¹Br are each about 50%).
别把 M+2 峰当成杂质。看到高度几乎 1 : 1 的一对峰，几乎可断定有 Br；高度 3 : 1 的一对，则是有 Cl。这是选择题里最爱考的一眼辨。Don't mistake the M+2 peak for an impurity. A nearly 1 : 1 pair almost certainly means Br; a 3 : 1 pair means Cl. This is a favourite one-glance multiple-choice test.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The peak with the largest m/z value is the molecular ion peak, M⁺, and its m/z gives the relative molecular mass. A 3 : 1 M : M+2 ratio indicates chlorine, while a 1 : 1 ratio indicates bromine.
例题Example
某含卤素的有机物，质谱的分子离子峰出现在 m/z = 78，另有一个 M+2 峰，高度约为 M 峰的三分之一。问：它含有哪种卤素？相对分子质量是多少？A halogen-containing organic compound has its molecular ion peak at m/z = 78, with an M+2 peak about one-third the height of M. Which halogen does it contain, and what is its relative molecular mass?
① M : M+2 ≈ 3 : 1，正是含 Cl 的特征（³⁵Cl : ³⁷Cl ≈ 3 : 1）。① M : M+2 ≈ 3 : 1, the signature of chlorine (³⁵Cl : ³⁷Cl ≈ 3 : 1). ② 分子离子峰 m/z = 78，所以 Mr = 78。② the molecular ion peak is at 78, so Mr = 78. ③ 补充：若含 Br 会是 1 : 1；若含 2 个 Cl，会出现 M : M+2 : M+4 ≈ 9 : 6 : 1。③ Extra: Br gives 1 : 1; two Cl atoms give M : M+2 : M+4 ≈ 9 : 6 : 1.
练习Practice
先看两根峰的高度关系，再对号入座。Compare the two peak heights first, then match the pattern.

某有机物质谱中，分子离子峰在 m/z = 94，其 M+2 峰高度与 M 峰几乎相等。该分子除 C、H、O 外还含哪种卤素？它的相对分子质量是多少？A mass spectrum has its molecular ion peak at m/z = 94, and the M+2 peak is almost the same height as M. Besides C, H and O, which halogen does the molecule contain, and what is its Mr?

点开看答案Show answer
M : M+2 ≈ 1 : 1 → 含 Br。相对分子质量 Mr = 94。 M : M+2 ≈ 1 : 1 → contains Br. Mr = 94.
— 第 1 站完成 —— Stop 1 done —
2 红外光谱：分子振动暴露官能团Infrared spectroscopy: vibrations reveal functional groups IR spectroscopy红外光谱
这一站要你会：背下必记特征吸收表，并说出某个官能团会落在哪个波数范围、长什么样。Goal: learn the must-know absorption table, and state the wavenumber range and shape of a given functional group's absorption.
把化学键想成一根根小弹簧，红外光像一束不同节奏的声波。弹簧只对和自己固有频率一致的外力起反应：O–H 这根「弹簧」软，振得慢，吸收的是低能量的红外；C=O 这根硬，振得快，吸的是另一段。所以每根键都在谱上留下自己的专属频道——你只要会查表，就能从谱里「听」出分子身上长了哪些零件。Think of bonds as little springs and infrared light as waves of different rhythms. A spring only responds to a force matching its own frequency: the O–H "spring" is soft and vibrates slowly, absorbing low-energy infrared; C=O is stiff and vibrates fast, absorbing another range. Each bond leaves its own channel on the spectrum — learn the table and you can "listen" to which parts a molecule carries.
必记特征吸收表（波数单位 cm⁻¹）：The absorption table to learn (wavenumber in cm⁻¹):
化学键Bond波数范围Wavenumber range长相Appearance
O–H（醇）O–H (alcohol)3200–3600宽broad
O–H（羧酸）O–H (carboxylic acid)2500–3300很宽very broad
C=OC=O1680–1750强而尖strong, sharp
C–HC–H2850–3100尖sharp
C–OC–O1000–1300尖sharp
N–HN–H3300–3500尖 / 中等sharp / medium
C≡NC≡N2220–2260尖sharp
  • 波数越大 = 能量越高 = 键越硬。记住 C=O 在 1700 左右这个「锚点」，其它都围着它记。Higher wavenumber = higher energy = stiffer bond. Anchor everything around C=O near 1700.
  • 两个 O–H 最容易混：醇的 O–H 较窄（3200–3600），羧酸的 O–H 又宽又低（一直铺到 2500）。The two O–H bands are easy to mix up: alcohol O–H is narrower (3200–3600), while acid O–H is broader and reaches down to 2500.
不用全背，先背两个：C=O（1700 附近，强而尖）和 O–H（3000 以上，宽）。这两个一出现，就能定下大半官能团。Start with just two: C=O (near 1700, strong and sharp) and O–H (above 3000, broad). These two alone settle most functional groups.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: A broad absorption between 3200 and 3600 cm⁻¹ is due to the O–H bond, while a strong, sharp absorption between 1680 and 1750 cm⁻¹ is due to the C=O bond.
例题Example
某化合物红外光谱在 1705 cm⁻¹ 附近有一强而尖的吸收，且在 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ 之间没有任何宽吸收。它最可能含什么官能团？为什么不会是醇？An infrared spectrum shows a strong, sharp absorption near 1705 cm⁻¹ and no broad absorption between 3200–3600 cm⁻¹. What functional group is most likely, and why is it not an alcohol?
① 1705 强而尖 → 有 C=O（羰基）。① strong, sharp peak at 1705 → C=O is present. ② 3200–3600 没有宽峰 → 没有醇的 O–H。② no broad peak at 3200–3600 → no alcohol O–H. ③ 结论：含羰基、但不含 O–H——是醛 / 酮 / 酯这类，不是醇（也不是羧酸）。③ So it has a carbonyl but no O–H — an aldehyde / ketone / ester, not an alcohol (nor an acid).
练习Practice
两处吸收一起看：一个定 C=O，一个定 O–H。Read the two absorptions together: one fixes C=O, the other fixes O–H.

某化合物在 2500–3300 cm⁻¹ 有一段很宽的吸收，同时 1710 cm⁻¹ 有强而尖的峰。判断它最可能含什么官能团，并说明理由。A compound shows a very broad absorption at 2500–3300 cm⁻¹ and a strong, sharp peak at 1710 cm⁻¹. Deduce its most likely functional group and explain.

点开看答案Show answer
羧酸 –COOH：1710 的强尖峰 = C=O；2500–3300 的「很宽」吸收 = 羧酸的 O–H（比醇的 O–H 更宽、更低）。两个合起来就是羧酸。 A carboxylic acid –COOH: the strong sharp peak at 1710 is C=O; the very broad 2500–3300 absorption is the acid O–H (wider and lower than an alcohol's). Together they point to a carboxylic acid.
— 第 2 站完成 —— Stop 2 done —
3 红外谱怎么读：先找 C=O 与 O–HReading an IR spectrum: C=O and O–H first Reading spectra读谱
这一站要你会：拿到一张红外谱，按「先 C=O、再 O–H」的顺序快速判断官能团，而不是从第一个峰看到最后一个。Goal: given an IR spectrum, judge the functional group quickly using the "C=O first, then O–H" routine instead of reading every peak.
读红外谱千万别从第一个峰看到最后一个，那样会累死。就抓两头：先在 1700 附近找有没有又强又尖的 C=O——有，就是醛、酮、酸、酯这一家子；没有，就排除它们。再在 3000 以上找有没有宽宽的「大包」O–H——有宽 O–H 的是醇或羧酸；羧酸的 O–H 更夸张，像山坡一样从 3300 一路铺到 2500，而醇的窄一点。两问下来，多数官能团就锁定了。Never read an IR spectrum from the first peak to the last — you'll exhaust yourself. Just grab two spots: first look near 1700 for a strong, sharp C=O — if it's there, you have the aldehyde/ketone/acid/ester family; if not, rule them out. Then look above 3000 for a broad O–H "bump" — a broad O–H means an alcohol or acid; the acid's O–H is more dramatic, sloping like a hill from 3300 all the way to 2500, while the alcohol's is narrower. Two questions and most functional groups are locked in.
读谱三步（顺序很重要）：Three reading steps (order matters):
  • ① 先找 C=O（1680–1750，强而尖）：有 → 醛 / 酮 / 羧酸 / 酯；无 → 醇 / 醚 / 胺等。① Look for C=O first (1680–1750, strong and sharp): present → aldehyde / ketone / acid / ester; absent → alcohol / ether / amine, etc.
  • ② 再看 O–H（3000 以上的宽峰）：有较宽的 → 醇；有更宽、压到 2500 的 → 羧酸。② Then look for O–H (broad, above 3000): a narrower one → alcohol; a wider one reaching to 2500 → carboxylic acid.
  • ③ 辅助线索：C–H 几乎都在；C≡N 在 2250 附近又尖又独特，一眼就能认。③ Helper clues: C–H is almost always present; C≡N near 2250 is sharp and distinctive, recognisable at a glance.
「宽不宽」是关键词。考试常拿它区分醇和酸：都含 O–H，但羧酸的 O–H 宽得夸张，能从 3300 一路铺到 2500；醇的 O–H 只占 3200–3600 这一段。"How broad" is the keyword. Exams use it to separate alcohols from acids: both have O–H, but the acid's O–H is dramatically broad, stretching from 3300 down to 2500, while an alcohol's O–H only fills 3200–3600.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The strong peak near 1700 cm⁻¹ shows that a C=O group is present. The absence of a broad O–H peak above 3000 cm⁻¹ rules out an alcohol or a carboxylic acid.
例题Example
一张红外谱：约 1720 cm⁻¹ 有强而尖的吸收；2900 cm⁻¹ 附近有 C–H 吸收；3000 cm⁻¹ 以上没有任何宽峰。判断它最可能属于哪一类，并说明理由。An IR spectrum shows a strong sharp absorption near 1720 cm⁻¹, C–H absorption near 2900 cm⁻¹, and no broad peak above 3000 cm⁻¹. Which class does it most likely belong to? Explain.
① 先找 C=O：1720 有强尖峰 → 含羰基 → 醛 / 酮 / 酯 / 酸。① C=O first: the strong sharp peak at 1720 means a carbonyl → aldehyde / ketone / ester / acid. ② 再看 O–H：3000 以上没有宽峰 → 不是醇，也不是羧酸。② Now O–H: nothing broad above 3000 → not an alcohol, nor an acid. ③ 结论：含羰基但无 O–H → 醛、酮或酯（三者需更多信息才能再区分）。③ So: carbonyl but no O–H → an aldehyde, ketone or ester (need more evidence to separate these three).
练习Practice
有 O–H 宽峰 + C–O，却没有 C=O，会是谁？A broad O–H plus C–O, but no C=O — who is that?

某化合物红外谱：3350 cm⁻¹ 有一宽峰，1050 cm⁻¹ 有一尖峰，2900 cm⁻¹ 有 C–H，1700 cm⁻¹ 附近无吸收。判断它含什么官能团。An IR spectrum shows a broad peak at 3350 cm⁻¹, a sharp peak at 1050 cm⁻¹, C–H at 2900 cm⁻¹, and nothing near 1700 cm⁻¹. Identify the functional group.

点开看答案Show answer
醇：3350 的宽峰 = O–H，1050 = C–O；没有 1700 的 C=O，排除了醛、酮、酸、酯。 An alcohol: the broad 3350 peak is O–H and 1050 is C–O; no C=O near 1700 rules out aldehydes, ketones, acids and esters.
— 第 3 站完成 —— Stop 3 done —
4 碳谱 ¹³C NMR：数碳环境Carbon-13 NMR: counting carbon environments Carbon-13 NMR碳谱
这一站要你会：数出一个分子里有几种「不同化学环境」的碳，并说出它的 ¹³C NMR 会有几个峰。Goal: count how many different chemical environments a molecule's carbons are in, and state how many peaks its ¹³C NMR will show.
碳谱的规则一句话：分子里有几种「处境不同」的碳，谱上就有几个峰。注意是「处境」，不是「个数」——两个碳要是处于完全对称的位置（像镜子里照出来的左右手），处境相同，只算一个峰。所以数峰之前，先找分子的对称轴；轴两边能对上的碳，都是「同一种人」，合并成一个峰。The rule in one sentence: the number of peaks equals the number of carbons in different environments. Notice it's about environment, not the number of atoms — two carbons in perfectly symmetric positions (like left and right hands in a mirror) share an environment and count as one. So before counting, find the molecule's axis of symmetry; carbons that match across it are "the same person" and merge into one peak.
数峰的三步：Three steps to count peaks:
  • 峰数 = 不同化学环境的碳原子数，不是碳总数。Number of peaks = number of different carbon environments, not the number of carbon atoms.
  • 怎么判「环境相同」：把每个碳的「左邻右舍」都列出来比较，周围连的东西完全一样 = 同一环境（通常因为对称）。How to spot equivalence: list each carbon's neighbours and compare; identical surroundings = same environment (usually from symmetry).
  • 两个例子：ethanol CH3CH2OH 有 2 种碳 → 2 个峰；propan-1-ol CH3CH2CH2OH 有 3 种碳 → 3 个峰。Two examples: ethanol CH3CH2OH has 2 carbon environments → 2 peaks; propan-1-ol CH3CH2CH2OH has 3 → 3 peaks.
别被「两个 CH₂」骗了。propan-1-ol 里有两个 CH₂，但它们一个邻着 CH₃、一个邻着 OH，处境不同，所以是两个不同的峰，不能合并。Don't be fooled by "two CH₂ groups". Propan-1-ol has two CH₂ groups, but one sits next to CH₃ and the other next to OH — different environments, so they give two separate peaks.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The number of peaks in a carbon-13 NMR spectrum equals the number of different carbon environments. Equivalent carbon atoms, such as those related by symmetry, produce only one peak.
例题Example
分别数一数 ethanol 和 propan-1-ol 的 ¹³C NMR 各有多少个峰。How many ¹³C NMR peaks do ethanol and propan-1-ol each show?
① ethanol CH3–CH2–OH：CH₃ 连 CH₂，CH₂ 连 CH₃ 和 OH——两种处境 → 2 个峰。① ethanol CH3–CH2–OH: CH₃ attaches to CH₂, CH₂ attaches to CH₃ and OH — two environments → 2 peaks. ② propan-1-ol CH3–CH2–CH2–OH：三个碳的左邻右舍都不一样 → 3 个峰。② propan-1-ol CH3–CH2–CH2–OH: all three carbons have different neighbours → 3 peaks.
练习Practice
先找对称轴，再数环境。Find the symmetry axis first, then count environments.

(a) propan-2-ol（CH3CH(OH)CH3）有几个 ¹³C 峰？(b) butan-1-ol（CH3CH2CH2CH2OH）有几个？(a) How many ¹³C peaks does propan-2-ol (CH3CH(OH)CH3) show? (b) How many for butan-1-ol (CH3CH2CH2CH2OH)?

点开看答案Show answer
(a) 两个 CH₃ 对称相等 + 中间 CH → 共 2 个峰。
(b) 四个碳处境各不相同 → 4 个峰。 (a) the two CH₃ are equivalent by symmetry, plus the central CH → 2 peaks.
(b) all four carbons are different → 4 peaks.
— 第 4 站完成 —— Stop 4 done —
5 氢谱 ¹H NMR：位移、面积、裂分Proton NMR: shift, area, splitting Proton NMR氢谱
这一站要你会：从氢谱读出三样东西——化学位移 δ（氢在什么环境）、峰面积比（氢的个数比）、裂分（邻碳上有几个氢）。Goal: read three things from a proton NMR — chemical shift δ (what environment), peak area ratio (how many H), and splitting (how many H on the neighbouring carbon).
氢谱是信息量最大的一张谱，也是考试最爱。它一次告诉你三件事：峰落在哪（化学位移 δ，说明这个氢「住在什么环境」）、峰有多大（面积比 = 氢原子个数比）、峰裂成几瓣（n+1 规则，说明邻碳上有几个等效氢）。就像一份简历：位置 = 岗位，面积 = 人数，裂分 = 邻座的同事。Proton NMR packs the most information and is the examiner's favourite. It tells you three things at once: where each peak sits (chemical shift δ, telling you what environment the proton lives in), how big each peak is (area ratio = ratio of proton counts), and how many parts it splits into (the n+1 rule, telling you how many equivalent protons sit next door). Like a CV: position = the job, area = the headcount, splitting = the colleague next door.
三个信息，逐个记：Three pieces of information:
氢的环境Proton environment化学位移 δ / ppmChemical shift δ / ppm
烷基（–CH）alkyl (–CH)0–2
连 O 的（如 CH–O）attached to O (e.g. CH–O)3–4
烯 / 芳环alkene / aromatic6–8
醛（–CHO）aldehyde (–CHO)9–10
酸（–COOH）acid (–COOH)10–12
  • 峰面积比 = 氢原子数目比（看积分曲线或峰高/峰面积）。Peak area ratio = ratio of proton numbers (from the integration trace, or peak heights/areas).
  • n+1 裂分：某组氢的邻碳上有 n 个等效氢，就裂成 n+1 重峰。The n+1 rule: a signal is split into n+1 peaks by n equivalent protons on the adjacent carbon.
n = 0 → singlet（单峰） n = 1 → doublet（二重） n = 2 → triplet（三重） n = 3 → quartet（四重）
两个必背数值：乙醇氢谱 3 组峰面积比 3 : 2 : 1（CH₃ 三重、CH₂ 四重、OH 单重）；ethanal 的醛氢 δ ≈ 9.8，一看到 9–10 这个位置就知道有醛基。Two numbers to memorise: ethanol gives 3 groups in ratio 3 : 2 : 1 (CH₃ triplet, CH₂ quartet, OH singlet); ethanal's aldehyde proton sits at δ ≈ 9.8 — a peak near 9–10 screams "aldehyde".
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The area under each peak is proportional to the number of protons in that environment. A signal split into n+1 peaks indicates n equivalent protons on the adjacent carbon atom.
例题Example
乙醇 CH3CH2OH 的氢谱有几组峰？面积比是多少？CH₃ 和 CH₂ 各裂成几重？How many groups of peaks does ethanol CH3CH2OH give? What is the area ratio, and how are the CH₃ and CH₂ signals split?
① 三组氢：CH₃、CH₂、OH → 3 组峰。① three sets of protons — CH₃, CH₂, OH → 3 groups. ② 面积比 = 氢个数比 = 3 : 2 : 1。② area ratio = proton ratio = 3 : 2 : 1. ③ CH₃ 邻碳 CH₂ 有 2 个 H → 2+1 = 三重峰（triplet）；CH₂ 邻碳 CH₃ 有 3 个 H → 3+1 = 四重峰（quartet）；OH 一般简化为单峰（singlet）。③ CH₃'s neighbour CH₂ has 2 H → 2+1 = triplet; CH₂'s neighbour CH₃ has 3 H → 3+1 = quartet; OH is usually treated as a singlet.
练习Practice
醛基的碳上没有氢，所以邻碳（CH₃）的 n = 0。The aldehyde carbon has no H, so for the neighbouring CH₃, n = 0.

ethanal CH3CHO 的氢谱：有几组峰？面积比？CH₃ 组裂成几重？For ethanal CH3CHO: how many groups? What area ratio? How is the CH₃ signal split?

点开看答案Show answer
两组峰（CH₃ 和 CHO），面积比 3 : 1。CH₃ 的邻碳是醛基碳、没有氢（n = 0）→ 单峰 singlet；醛氢也在 δ ≈ 9.8，是单峰。 Two groups (CH₃ and CHO), area ratio 3 : 1. The CH₃'s neighbouring aldehyde carbon has no H (n = 0) → a singlet; the aldehyde proton near δ ≈ 9.8 is also a singlet.
— 第 5 站完成 —— Stop 5 done —
6 三谱合一：像侦探一样推出结构Combining evidence: deduce the structure Structure elucidation结构推断
这一站要你会：给定分子式 + IR + NMR，按固定流程推出唯一的结构。Goal: given a molecular formula plus IR and NMR data, deduce the unique structure using a fixed routine.
光谱题其实就是一道侦探推理题：分子式给你「嫌疑人总名单」（有多少 C、H、O），红外告诉你「他穿了什么装备」（官能团），氢谱告诉你「这些人怎么站队」（骨架与氢的分布），三样一拼，结构就唯一了。步骤永远是一套：先算不饱和度 → 看红外定官能团 → 用 NMR 定骨架 → 拼结构，最后再拿所有数据反查一遍，对得上就收工。A spectroscopy question is really a detective puzzle: the molecular formula gives the list of suspects (how many C, H, O), the IR tells you what equipment they carry (functional groups), and the NMR tells you how they line up (skeleton and H distribution). Put the three together and the structure is unique. The routine is always the same: unsaturation first → IR for functional groups → NMR for the skeleton → assemble, then check every piece of data against your answer and you're done.
标准四步流程：The standard four-step routine:
不饱和度 = (2C + 2 − H) / 2 （只含 C、H、O 时） 每个双键或环 = 1 个不饱和度（C=O 也算 1 个）
  • ① 算不饱和度：知道分子里有几个双键 / 环，心里先有个谱。① Degree of unsaturation: know how many double bonds / rings there are before anything else.
  • ② IR 定官能团：有没有 C=O？O–H？C≡N？把「零件」认出来。② IR fixes functional groups: any C=O? O–H? C≡N? Identify the parts.
  • ③ NMR 定骨架：碳谱给碳环境数，氢谱给氢个数比与裂分，拼出骨架。③ NMR fixes the skeleton: carbon NMR gives environments, proton NMR gives H ratios and splitting — build the skeleton.
  • ④ 拼结构并反查：把结构写出来，再逐条对回所有数据，全部吻合才算过。④ Assemble and check back: write the structure, then match every piece of data to it — only pass when everything agrees.
不饱和度公式只对 C、H、O 有效。若分子含 N 或卤素要修正，但 AS 阶段绝大多数只考 C/H/O，先把这套记熟。The unsaturation formula only works for C, H and O. Molecules with N or halogens need a correction, but AS almost always sticks to C/H/O — learn this version well first.
🗣 考场英文怎么说：How to say it in the exam: The degree of unsaturation, the infrared absorptions and the NMR data together allow the structure to be deduced. Each piece of evidence must be consistent with the final structure.
例题Example
某化合物分子式为 C3H6O。IR 在 1710 cm⁻¹ 有强吸收。¹H NMR 只有一组峰：δ 2.1（单峰，6H）。推出它的结构。A compound has the formula C3H6O. Its IR shows a strong absorption at 1710 cm⁻¹. Its ¹H NMR shows a single peak: δ 2.1 (singlet, 6H). Deduce the structure.
① 不饱和度 = (2×3 + 2 − 6)/2 = 1 → 一个双键。① unsaturation = (2×3 + 2 − 6)/2 = 1 → one double bond. ② IR 1710 强 → C=O 占掉这个双键，且没有 O–H（否则谱上会有宽峰）。② strong IR at 1710 → a C=O takes that double bond, with no O–H (a broad peak would otherwise appear). ③ NMR 只有一组 6H 单峰 → 6 个氢完全等价，且邻碳无氢 → 两个等价的 CH₃，中间夹一个 C=O。③ a single 6H singlet → all six protons equivalent, with no H on a neighbour → two equivalent CH₃ flanking a C=O. ④ 拼出 CH3COCH3（propanone，丙酮）。反查：3 个碳（两个等价）、6 个氢全同、一个 C=O——全部吻合。④ assemble CH3COCH3 (propanone). Check: 3 carbons (two equivalent), 6 identical H, one C=O — everything fits.
练习Practice
按四步走：不饱和度 → IR → NMR → 拼结构。Follow the four steps: unsaturation → IR → NMR → assemble.

某化合物分子式为 C2H6O。IR 在 3350 cm⁻¹ 有宽峰，1700 cm⁻¹ 附近无吸收。¹H NMR 三组峰，面积比 3 : 2 : 1，分别为三重峰、四重峰、单峰。推出结构。A compound has the formula C2H6O. Its IR shows a broad peak at 3350 cm⁻¹ and nothing near 1700 cm⁻¹. Its ¹H NMR shows three groups in ratio 3 : 2 : 1 — a triplet, a quartet and a singlet. Deduce the structure.

点开看答案Show answer
不饱和度 = (2×2 + 2 − 6)/2 = 0，无环无双键。IR 无 1700 的 C=O，3350 宽峰 = O–H → 是醇。NMR 三组 3 : 2 : 1（三重 + 四重 + 单重）→ CH3CH2OH（ethanol）。 Unsaturation = (2×2 + 2 − 6)/2 = 0, no ring or double bond. No C=O near 1700, broad 3350 = O–H → an alcohol. NMR 3 : 2 : 1 (triplet + quartet + singlet) → CH3CH2OH (ethanol).
— 第 6 站完成 —— Stop 6 done —

单元 18 小结Unit 18 summary

① 质谱：分子离子峰 M⁺ 给相对分子质量；M : M+2 的 3 : 1 是 Cl、1 : 1 是 Br。
② 红外：每根键有专属频道——先记 C=O（1700 附近，强尖）和 O–H（3000 以上，宽）两个「锚点」。
③ 核磁：碳谱看碳环境数（对称会合并）；氢谱看位移 δ + 面积比 + n+1 裂分。
④ 综合题就是侦探四步：算不饱和度 → IR 定官能团 → NMR 定骨架 → 拼结构再反查。① Mass spec: the molecular ion M⁺ gives Mr; M : M+2 of 3 : 1 means Cl, 1 : 1 means Br.
② Infrared: each bond has its own channel — learn the two anchors first: C=O (near 1700, strong and sharp) and O–H (above 3000, broad).
③ NMR: carbon spectra count carbon environments (symmetry merges them); proton spectra give shift δ + area ratio + n+1 splitting.
④ A combined question is a four-step detective job: unsaturation → IR for functional groups → NMR for the skeleton → assemble and check back.

这一单元是整条线的「收尾」：前面学过的官能团、异构体、结构式，到了这里全部变成一张谱上的信号。拿到谱不再慌，按「先看它有什么，再拼它长什么样」的思路走，你就是在替分子做自我介绍。This unit ties everything together: the functional groups, isomers and structures you met earlier all become signals on a spectrum. Don't panic at a spectrum — follow "first see what it has, then build what it looks like", and you are letting the molecule introduce itself.

闭眼也要写得出的方程式Equations to write with your eyes shut

① 钠与水： 2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂ ② 镁与蒸汽：Mg + H₂O(g) → MgO + H₂ ③ Haber 法：N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ ④ 氯的歧化：Cl₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCl + HClO ⑤ 溴水褪色：CH₂=CH₂ + Br₂ → CH₂BrCH₂Br ⑥ 发酵制醇：C₆H₁₂O₆ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂ ⑦ 酯化： CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH ⇌ CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O ⑧ 碳酸钙分解：CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ ⑨ 接触法： S + O₂ → SO₂；2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃

这 9 条覆盖了无机、有机、工业三条线的高频反应，背熟后大部分推断题都能顺藤摸瓜。These nine cover the most common reactions across inorganic, organic and industrial chemistry — memorise them and most deduction questions unravel themselves.

建议顺序：① 先开「动手玩」里的 PhET 搭原子，建立手感 → ② 跟着本页十个单元走 → ③ 用「看课」补不懂的地方 → ④ 用「题库」做真题。化学一定要动手算，光看不练等于没学。Suggested order: ① open the PhET "Build an Atom" below to get a feel for atoms → ② work through this page's 18 units → ③ fill gaps with the video sites → ④ do past papers. 五、没有电脑也能练的 10 件事5 · Ten things to practise without a computer

纸笔就能做的化学基本功，每天挑一两件。Pen-and-paper drills you can do anywhere.

  1. 默写前 20 号元素的符号与相对原子质量。Write out symbols and Ar of the first 20 elements.
  2. 默写电子排布：从 H 到 Ca，再挑几个离子（Cl⁻、Fe²⁺、Cu²⁺）。Write electron configurations H → Ca, plus a few ions.
  3. 每天配平 3 条方程式（随便从课本挑）。Balance three equations a day.
  4. 默写 VSEPR 形状表（6 种形状 + 键角 + 例子）。Reproduce the VSEPR table from memory.
  5. 给自己出摩尔换算题：g ↔ mol ↔ 浓度 ↔ 气体体积。Set yourself mole conversions in all four directions.
  6. 默写第 3 周期从 Na 到 Cl 的氧化物与其酸碱性。List Period 3 oxides and their acid–base nature.
  7. 默写有机官能团表与命名后缀。Recite the functional-group table and suffixes.
  8. 画出 C₄H₈ 的所有结构异构体。Draw all structural isomers of C₄H₈.
  9. 用 Hess 循环重算一次课堂上的例题。Redo a Hess's-law example as a cycle.
  10. 默写本页速查表第 11 组的九条方程式。Write out the nine equations from group 11 of the cheat sheet.

别在「找资料」上花太多时间——把本页 18 个单元看懂 + 每天动手算几题，比收藏一百个网站有用。需要的话再回来翻。Don't over-invest in "finding resources" — understand the 18 units here and do a few calculations a day; that beats bookmarking a hundred sites. Come back when you need more.

先懂原理，再记术语，最后才是刷题Understand the idea, learn the term, then practise

化学这门课，一半是算（摩尔、焓变、pH、Kc），一半是说（解释趋势、描述机理）。配图和「说人话」帮你看懂微观发生了什么；🗣 考场英文怎么说 帮你把解释题的分拿到手；例题负责算，练习负责验。不要死背方程式——每一条都先想清楚「哪些旧键断、哪些新键成」，你会发现方程式自己会写出来。Half of chemistry is calculating (moles, enthalpy, pH, Kc) and half is explaining (trends, mechanisms). The diagrams and "in plain words" boxes show you what happens at particle level; the 🗣 How to say it in the exam boxes win the "explain" marks; examples cover calculation, practice checks it. Never learn an equation by rote — always work out which old bonds break and which new bonds form, and the equation writes itself.
